disagree.en: Students may disagree while still respecting one another.
disagree.zh: 學生可以有不同意見，同時仍彼此尊重。

disappear.en: The clouds began to disappear as the weather improved.
disappear.zh: 天氣好轉時，雲開始散去。

disappoint.en: The canceled trip will disappoint many students who were excited about it.
disappoint.zh: 取消這趟旅行會讓許多期待已久的學生失望。

disaster.en: The town created a new emergency plan after the natural disaster.
disaster.zh: 這個城鎮在天然災害後制定了新的緊急應變計畫。

discipline.en: Regular practice requires patience and self-discipline.
discipline.zh: 規律練習需要耐心和自律。

disclose.en: The report must disclose the source of every important statistic.
disclose.zh: 這份報告必須揭露每項重要統計資料的來源。

discount.en: Students receive a discount when buying tickets with school identification.
discount.zh: 學生出示學生證購票可享折扣。

discover.en: Students may discover new patterns when they organize the data clearly.
discover.zh: 學生把資料整理清楚後，可能會發現新的規律。

discovery.en: The discovery led researchers to ask several new questions.
discovery.zh: 這項發現使研究人員提出了幾個新問題。

discuss.en: We will discuss the article in small groups tomorrow.
discuss.zh: 我們明天會分小組討論這篇文章。

discussion.en: The discussion became more useful after students began using evidence.
discussion.zh: 學生開始使用證據後，討論變得更有意義。

disease.en: The lesson explains how exercise can reduce the risk of disease.
disease.zh: 這堂課說明運動如何降低疾病風險。

dish.en: This dish is made with rice, vegetables, and fresh fish.
dish.zh: 這道料理由米飯、蔬菜和新鮮魚類製成。

disk.en: The file was saved on an external disk for backup.
disk.zh: 這個檔案被儲存在外接磁碟中作為備份。

display.en: The screen will display your score after the quiz ends.
display.zh: 小考結束後，螢幕會顯示你的分數。

dispose.en: Students must dispose of used materials according to laboratory rules.
dispose.zh: 學生必須依照實驗室規定處理使用過的材料。

disrupt.en: Heavy rain may disrupt transportation across the region this evening.
disrupt.zh: 大雨今晚可能會打亂整個地區的交通。

distance.en: The distance from the station to the school is about two kilometers.
distance.zh: 車站到學校的距離大約兩公里。

distant.en: The mountain looked distant even though the sky was clear.
distant.zh: 即使天空晴朗，那座山看起來仍很遙遠。

distinguish.en: Students learn to distinguish reliable sources from unreliable ones.
distinguish.zh: 學生學習分辨可靠與不可靠的資料來源。

distribute.en: The teacher will distribute the worksheets before the activity begins.
distribute.zh: 活動開始前老師會發下學習單。

distribution.en: The chart shows the distribution of scores across the class.
distribution.zh: 這張圖表顯示全班分數的分布。

district.en: The school is located in a quiet residential district.
district.zh: 這所學校位於安靜的住宅區。

diverse.en: The club includes students from diverse backgrounds and interests.
diverse.zh: 這個社團包含來自不同背景與興趣的學生。

divide.en: Divide the class into four groups before starting the activity.
divide.zh: 活動開始前，把全班分成四組。

doctor.en: The doctor advised him to rest and drink more water.
doctor.zh: 醫師建議他多休息並多喝水。

document.en: Save the document before closing the computer program.
document.zh: 關閉電腦程式前要先儲存文件。

dog.en: The dog waited quietly outside the store for its owner.
dog.zh: 那隻狗安靜地在店外等主人。

domestic.en: Domestic travel increased during the long holiday weekend.
domestic.zh: 連假期間國內旅遊增加了。

door.en: Please close the door quietly when you leave.
door.zh: 離開時請輕輕把門關上。

double.en: The number of participants may double if registration remains open.
double.zh: 如果持續開放報名，參與人數可能會增加一倍。

doubt.en: There is little doubt that practice improves performance over time.
doubt.zh: 長期而言，練習能提升表現幾乎沒有疑問。

down.en: Please write the key points down before the discussion ends.
down.zh: 討論結束前請把重點寫下來。

download.en: Students can download the worksheet from the class website.
download.zh: 學生可以從班級網站下載學習單。

dozen.en: The bakery prepared a dozen sandwiches for the school event.
dozen.zh: 麵包店為學校活動準備了十二個三明治。

draft.en: Please finish the first draft before asking your partner for feedback.
draft.zh: 在請同學提供回饋前，請先完成初稿。

drag.en: You can drag the file into the folder with the mouse.
drag.zh: 你可以用滑鼠把檔案拖進資料夾。

draw.en: Draw a simple diagram to show how the system works.
draw.zh: 請畫一個簡單圖示，說明這個系統如何運作。

dream.en: Her dream is to study marine biology in the future.
dream.zh: 她的夢想是未來學習海洋生物學。

dress.en: Students should dress appropriately for the formal ceremony.
dress.zh: 學生應為正式典禮穿著得體。

drink.en: Remember to drink enough water during long study sessions.
drink.zh: 長時間讀書時記得喝足夠的水。

drive.en: It takes about twenty minutes to drive from school to the station.
drive.zh: 從學校開車到車站大約需要二十分鐘。

driver.en: The bus driver waited until every student was seated.
driver.zh: 公車司機等到每位學生都坐好才開車。

drop.en: The temperature can drop quickly after sunset in the mountains.
drop.zh: 山區日落後氣溫可能快速下降。

dry.en: Keep the equipment in a dry place after cleaning it.
dry.zh: 清潔設備後請放在乾燥的地方。

due.en: The assignment is due at the end of next week.

duration.en: The duration of the experiment was exactly thirty minutes.
duration.zh: 這項實驗的持續時間正好是三十分鐘。

during.en: Please remain quiet during the listening section of the exam.
during.zh: 考試聽力部分進行時請保持安靜。

dust.en: A thin layer of dust covered the unused bookshelf.
dust.zh: 沒使用的書架上覆著一層薄薄的灰塵。

duty.en: It is the monitor's duty to collect the worksheets after class.
duty.zh: 收學習單是班長下課後的職責。

dynamic.en: The classroom became more dynamic after students began working in groups.
dynamic.zh: 學生開始分組活動後，課堂變得更有活力。

each.en: Each student received a different question to discuss with the group.
each.zh: 每位學生都拿到不同的問題與小組討論。

eager.en: The students were eager to see the results of the experiment.
eager.zh: 學生們很期待看到實驗結果。

ear.en: The doctor examined his ear after he reported discomfort.
ear.zh: 他表示耳朵不舒服後，醫師檢查了他的耳朵。

early.en: We arrived early so we could prepare the room before class.
early.zh: 我們提早到達，好在上課前準備教室。

earn.en: Students can earn extra credit by completing the optional project.
earn.zh: 學生完成選做專題可以獲得額外加分。

earth.en: The earth moves around the sun once every year.
earth.zh: 地球每年繞太陽運行一圈。

earthquake.en: The earthquake damaged several older buildings in the city.
earthquake.zh: 這場地震損壞了城裡幾棟較老的建築。

ease.en: A clear schedule can ease stress before major exams.
ease.zh: 清楚的時間表能減輕大考前的壓力。

east.en: The sun rises in the east every morning.
east.zh: 太陽每天早上從東方升起。

eastern.en: Heavy rain affected several towns along the eastern coast.
eastern.zh: 大雨影響了東部沿海的幾個城鎮。

easy.en: The first question was easy, but the last one was challenging.
easy.zh: 第一題很簡單，但最後一題很有挑戰性。

eat.en: We usually eat lunch together after the fourth class.
eat.zh: 我們通常第四節課後一起吃午餐。

economic.en: The report explains how tourism supports local economic growth.
economic.zh: 這份報告說明觀光如何支持地方經濟成長。

economy.en: A strong economy can create more job opportunities for young people.
economy.zh: 強健的經濟可以為年輕人創造更多工作機會。

edge.en: Do not stand too close to the edge of the platform.
edge.zh: 不要站得太靠近月台邊緣。

edit.en: Please edit your essay carefully before submitting the final version.
edit.zh: 提交最終版本前請仔細修改文章。

edition.en: The library received the latest edition of the science textbook.
edition.zh: 圖書館收到最新版的自然科教科書。

editor.en: The editor checked the article for unclear sentences and errors.
editor.zh: 編輯檢查文章中不清楚的句子和錯誤。

educate.en: Schools should educate students about responsible use of technology.
educate.zh: 學校應教育學生負責任地使用科技。

education.en: Education can provide people with more choices for the future.
education.zh: 教育能為人們的未來提供更多選擇。

educational.en: The museum offers educational programs for students of different ages.
educational.zh: 博物館為不同年齡的學生提供教育活動。

effect.en: The new study method had a positive effect on test performance.
effect.zh: 新的讀書方法對考試表現產生了正面效果。

effective.en: Regular review is an effective way to remember new vocabulary.
effective.zh: 規律複習是記住新單字的有效方法。

efficiency.en: The new system improved efficiency by reducing unnecessary paperwork.
efficiency.zh: 新系統透過減少不必要的文書作業提升效率。

efficient.en: This route is more efficient because it avoids heavy traffic.
efficient.zh: 這條路線因避開塞車而更有效率。

effort.en: Her improvement was the result of steady effort over several months.
effort.zh: 她的進步是數月持續努力的結果。

egg.en: She added an egg to the bowl before mixing the ingredients.
egg.zh: 她在攪拌材料前先在碗裡加入一顆蛋。

either.en: You can choose either topic for your final presentation.
either.zh: 期末報告兩個主題你可以任選一個。

elaborate.en: Please elaborate on your answer with one clear supporting example.
elaborate.zh: 請用一個清楚的支持例子進一步說明你的答案。

elderly.en: The program provides free transportation for elderly residents in the area.
elderly.zh: 這項計畫為當地年長居民提供免費交通服務。

elect.en: Students will elect a class representative at the next meeting.
elect.zh: 學生將在下次班會選出班級代表。

election.en: The school election gave students a chance to practice democratic participation.
election.zh: 校內選舉讓學生有機會練習民主參與。

electric.en: The school replaced an old bus with an electric one.
electric.zh: 學校用電動巴士取代了一輛老舊巴士。

electrical.en: Electrical equipment should be kept away from water.

electricity.en: The solar panels produce enough electricity for several classrooms.
electricity.zh: 這些太陽能板能為數間教室提供足夠電力。

electronic.en: Students submit most assignments through an electronic learning system.
electronic.zh: 學生大多透過電子學習系統繳交作業。

element.en: Trust is an important element of successful teamwork.
element.zh: 信任是成功團隊合作的重要要素。

elementary.en: The program introduces elementary coding skills to younger students.
elementary.zh: 這項計畫向年幼學生介紹基礎程式設計技能。

eliminate.en: The team tried to eliminate unnecessary steps from the process.
eliminate.zh: 團隊試著刪除流程中不必要的步驟。

else.en: If this solution fails, we will need to try something else.
else.zh: 如果這個方法失敗，我們就得試別的方法。

email.en: Please send me an email if the meeting time changes.
email.zh: 如果會議時間改變，請寄電子郵件告訴我。

embarrass.en: The teacher avoided questions that might embarrass students in front of classmates.
embarrass.zh: 老師避免提出可能讓學生在同學面前尷尬的問題。

emerge.en: A clear pattern began to emerge after more data were collected.
emerge.zh: 蒐集更多資料後，一個明顯的模式開始出現。

emergency.en: Every classroom has clear instructions for what to do in an emergency.
emergency.zh: 每間教室都有緊急情況時該怎麼做的清楚指示。

emotion.en: Music can express emotion even when no words are used.
emotion.zh: 即使沒有歌詞，音樂也能表達情感。

emotional.en: The ending of the film was emotional but not overly dramatic.
emotional.zh: 電影結尾很感人，但並不過度煽情。

emphasize.en: The coach used the meeting to emphasize the importance of teamwork.
emphasize.zh: 教練利用會議強調團隊合作的重要性。

employ.en: The company plans to employ more workers next year.
employ.zh: 這家公司計畫明年聘用更多員工。

employee.en: Each employee received training before using the new system.
employee.zh: 每位員工使用新系統前都接受了訓練。

employer.en: The employer offered flexible hours during the busy season.
employer.zh: 雇主在忙碌季節提供彈性工時。

employment.en: The course teaches practical skills that may improve future employment opportunities.
employment.zh: 這門課教授可能提升未來就業機會的實用技能。

empty.en: The classroom was empty when I arrived after school.
empty.zh: 我放學後到達時，教室裡沒有人。

enable.en: Digital tools enable students to organize information more easily.
enable.zh: 數位工具讓學生能更容易整理資訊。

encounter.en: Students often encounter unfamiliar words when reading academic articles.
encounter.zh: 學生閱讀學術文章時常會遇到不熟悉的單字。

encourage.en: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions when they are confused.
encourage.zh: 老師應鼓勵學生在困惑時提出問題。

end.en: Please hand in your worksheet at the end of class.

endure.en: Some plants can endure long periods with very little water.
endure.zh: 有些植物可以忍受長時間缺水。

energy.en: Solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
energy.zh: 太陽能可以減少對化石燃料的依賴。

enforce.en: Schools enforce safety rules to protect students during laboratory activities.
enforce.zh: 學校會執行安全規定，以保護進行實驗活動的學生。

engage.en: Good questions can engage students in deeper discussion.
engage.zh: 好問題能讓學生投入更深入的討論。

engine.en: The mechanic checked the engine before the long trip.
engine.zh: 長途旅行前，技師檢查了引擎。

engineer.en: The engineer tested the bridge design before construction began.
engineer.zh: 工程師在施工前測試了橋梁設計。

engineering.en: She hopes to study engineering and design useful technology.
engineering.zh: 她希望學習工程並設計實用科技。

enhance.en: Better lighting can enhance concentration in the study area.
enhance.zh: 更好的照明可以提升讀書區的專注力。

enjoy.en: Many students enjoy learning through games and group activities.
enjoy.zh: 許多學生喜歡透過遊戲和小組活動學習。

enormous.en: The project required an enormous amount of time and careful planning.
enormous.zh: 這項專題需要大量時間與仔細規劃。

enough.en: We have enough time to review the final chapter today.
enough.zh: 我們今天有足夠時間複習最後一章。

ensure.en: Double-check the instructions to ensure every step is completed.
ensure.zh: 再次確認說明，以確保每個步驟都完成。

enter.en: Students must enter their ID number before starting the test.
enter.zh: 學生開始測驗前必須輸入學號。

entertain.en: The short performance was designed to entertain visitors during the break.
entertain.zh: 這場短演出是為了在休息時間娛樂訪客。

entertainment.en: The festival offers music, food, and entertainment for families.
entertainment.zh: 這個節慶提供音樂、美食和適合家庭的娛樂活動。

entire.en: The entire class worked together to finish the project.
entire.zh: 全班一起合作完成了這項專題。

entity.en: Each organization is treated as a separate entity in the database.
entity.zh: 資料庫會把每個組織視為獨立實體。

entrance.en: Students gathered near the main entrance before the museum opened.
entrance.zh: 博物館開門前，學生聚集在主要入口附近。

entry.en: Each contest entry must include a title and short description.
entry.zh: 每件參賽作品都必須附上標題和簡短說明。

environment.en: A quiet environment can help students concentrate for longer periods.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能幫助學生更長時間保持專注。

environmental.en: The class discussed several environmental problems affecting local communities.
environmental.zh: 全班討論了幾個影響當地社區的環境問題。

equal.en: Each group should receive an equal amount of time to present.
equal.zh: 每組都應獲得相同的報告時間。

equate.en: We should not equate a high score with complete understanding.
equate.zh: 我們不應把高分直接等同於完全理解。

equip.en: The school will equip the new classroom with digital learning tools.
equip.zh: 學校會為新教室配備數位學習工具。

equipment.en: Students must return all equipment after finishing the experiment.
equipment.zh: 學生完成實驗後必須歸還所有器材。

equivalent.en: The two measurements are approximately equivalent after unit conversion.
equivalent.zh: 經過單位換算後，這兩個測量值大致相等。

error.en: A small error in the data changed the final result.
error.zh: 資料中的一個小錯誤改變了最後結果。

escape.en: The hikers followed the marked trail to escape the heavy rain.
escape.zh: 健行者沿著標示步道避開大雨。

especially.en: This chapter is especially important for the final exam.
especially.zh: 這一章對期末考尤其重要。

essay.en: Her essay presents a clear argument supported by strong evidence.
essay.zh: 她的文章提出清楚論點並有有力證據支持。

essential.en: Clean water is essential for human health and survival.
essential.zh: 乾淨的水對人類健康與生存至關重要。

establish.en: The club hopes to establish a regular reading program this semester.
establish.zh: 社團希望這學期建立固定的閱讀計畫。

estimate.en: We can estimate the distance by using the map scale.
estimate.zh: 我們可以利用地圖比例尺估算距離。

ethical.en: Researchers must follow ethical rules when collecting personal information.
ethical.zh: 研究人員蒐集個人資訊時必須遵守倫理規範。

evaluate.en: Students evaluate each source before using it in their reports.
evaluate.zh: 學生在報告中使用資料前會先評估每個來源。

even.en: Even a short walk can help improve your mood.
even.zh: 即使只是短暫散步，也能幫助改善心情。

evening.en: The library stays open until nine in the evening.
evening.zh: 圖書館晚上開放到九點。

event.en: The school event attracted more visitors than expected.
event.zh: 這場校內活動吸引的訪客比預期多。

ever.en: Have you ever visited a science museum at night?
ever.zh: 你曾經在晚上參觀過科學博物館嗎？

every.en: Every student must bring a notebook to the workshop.
every.zh: 每位學生都必須帶筆記本參加工作坊。

everyone.en: Everyone in the group contributed at least one idea.
everyone.zh: 小組裡每個人都至少提出了一個想法。

everything.en: Please check that everything is ready before the presentation begins.
everything.zh: 報告開始前請確認所有東西都準備好了。

evidence.en: Strong evidence is necessary to support a scientific conclusion.
evidence.zh: 有力證據是支持科學結論所必需的。

evoke.en: The old photograph can evoke strong memories of childhood.
evoke.zh: 這張老照片能喚起強烈的童年回憶。

exact.en: Please record the exact time when the reaction begins.
exact.zh: 請記錄反應開始的確切時間。

exaggerate.en: Graphs should not exaggerate small differences by using a misleading scale.
exaggerate.zh: 圖表不應用誤導性的比例尺誇大小差異。

exam.en: She reviewed vocabulary every night before the exam.
exam.zh: 考試前她每天晚上都複習單字。

examine.en: The researchers will examine the samples under a microscope.
examine.zh: 研究人員會在顯微鏡下檢查樣本。

example.en: The teacher gave an example to explain the difficult grammar rule.
example.zh: 老師舉了一個例子來解釋困難的文法規則。

exceed.en: Do not exceed the maximum amount shown in the instructions.
exceed.zh: 不要超過說明中標示的最大數量。

excellent.en: She received excellent feedback on her final presentation.
excellent.zh: 她的期末報告獲得了非常好的回饋。

except.en: Everyone attended the meeting except one student who was sick.
except.zh: 除了生病的一位學生外，所有人都參加了會議。

exchange.en: The exchange program allows students to experience another culture directly.
exchange.zh: 交換計畫讓學生能直接體驗另一種文化。

excite.en: New discoveries can excite students and make science feel more relevant.
excite.zh: 新發現能讓學生感到興奮，也讓科學更貼近生活。

excited.en: The students were excited about visiting the new exhibition.
excited.zh: 學生對參觀新展覽感到很興奮。

exciting.en: The final game was exciting from beginning to end.
exciting.zh: 最後一場比賽從頭到尾都很精彩。

exclude.en: The study will exclude incomplete responses from the final analysis.
exclude.zh: 這項研究會把不完整的回答排除在最後分析之外。

excuse.en: He gave a reasonable excuse for arriving late to class.
excuse.zh: 他為上課遲到提出了一個合理理由。

exercise.en: Regular exercise can improve both physical and mental health.
exercise.zh: 規律運動能改善身心健康。

exert.en: Strong winds can exert considerable force on tall buildings.
exert.zh: 強風會對高樓施加相當大的力量。

exhibit.en: The museum will exhibit student projects during the science festival.
exhibit.zh: 博物館會在科學節期間展出學生作品。

exist.en: Several possible solutions exist for this problem.
exist.zh: 這個問題有數種可能的解決方法。

existence.en: The discovery confirmed the existence of water beneath the surface.
existence.zh: 這項發現證實了地表下有水存在。

expand.en: The city plans to expand the bicycle network next year.
expand.zh: 市政府計畫明年擴大自行車路網。

expect.en: We expect the results to improve after more practice.
expect.zh: 我們預期增加練習後結果會改善。

expense.en: The school covered the travel expense for the competition.
expense.zh: 學校負擔了比賽的交通費用。

expensive.en: The new equipment is expensive but more reliable.
expensive.zh: 新設備很昂貴，但更可靠。

experience.en: Volunteering gave her useful experience in working with children.
experience.zh: 志工服務讓她獲得與兒童相處的實用經驗。

experiment.en: The experiment tested how light affects plant growth.
experiment.zh: 這項實驗測試光線如何影響植物生長。

expert.en: An expert visited the class to explain renewable energy technology.
expert.zh: 一位專家到班上說明再生能源技術。

explain.en: Please explain your answer using evidence from the passage.
explain.zh: 請用文章中的證據解釋你的答案。

explanation.en: Her explanation was clear enough for everyone to follow.
explanation.zh: 她的解釋很清楚，每個人都能理解。

explicit.en: The instructions give explicit rules for formatting the report.
explicit.zh: 說明中明確列出報告格式的規則。

exploit.en: The design aims to exploit natural light during the daytime.
exploit.zh: 這項設計旨在白天充分利用自然光。

explore.en: Students used the website to explore different career options.
explore.zh: 學生使用網站探索不同的職涯選擇。

export.en: The program can export the results as a spreadsheet file.
export.zh: 這個程式可以把結果匯出成試算表檔案。

expose.en: The activity can expose students to ideas from different cultures.
expose.zh: 這項活動能讓學生接觸來自不同文化的觀點。

express.en: Students should learn to express their ideas clearly and politely.
express.zh: 學生應學會清楚且有禮貌地表達想法。

expression.en: Her facial expression showed that she was surprised.
expression.zh: 她的臉部表情顯示她很驚訝。

extend.en: The teacher agreed to extend the deadline by two days.
extend.zh: 老師同意把截止日期延後兩天。

external.en: External factors such as weather can affect the final result.
external.zh: 天氣等外部因素可能影響最後結果。

extra.en: We had extra time to check our answers before class ended.
extra.zh: 下課前我們有額外時間檢查答案。

extract.en: Students extract key information from the passage before answering questions.
extract.zh: 學生回答問題前先從文章中擷取關鍵資訊。

eye.en: The bright light made it difficult to keep one eye open.
eye.zh: 強光讓人很難睜開一隻眼睛。

face.en: Students often face new challenges when they enter high school.
face.zh: 學生進入高中後常會面臨新的挑戰。

facilitate.en: Clear instructions can facilitate cooperation during group activities.
facilitate.zh: 清楚的說明可以促進小組活動中的合作。

facility.en: The new sports facility includes a gym and an indoor court.
facility.zh: 新的運動設施包含健身房與室內球場。

fact.en: Please separate each fact from personal opinion in your notes.
fact.zh: 請在筆記中把每項事實與個人意見分開。

factor.en: Sleep is an important factor in students' ability to concentrate.
factor.zh: 睡眠是影響學生專注能力的重要因素。

factory.en: The factory installed new equipment to reduce energy use.
factory.zh: 這家工廠安裝新設備以降低能源使用。

fail.en: Do not be afraid to fail when trying something new.
fail.zh: 嘗試新事物時不要害怕失敗。

failure.en: Failure can provide useful information about how to improve a design.
failure.zh: 失敗可以提供如何改進設計的有用資訊。

fair.en: The teacher used clear rules to make the competition fair.
fair.zh: 老師用明確規則讓比賽保持公平。

fairly.en: The teacher tried to grade every report fairly.
fairly.zh: 老師努力公平地評分每份報告。

fall.en: Temperatures usually fall quickly after sunset in the mountains.
fall.zh: 山區日落後氣溫通常會快速下降。

false.en: The article contained several false claims that lacked evidence.
false.zh: 這篇文章包含幾項缺乏證據的錯誤主張。

familiar.en: The song sounded familiar even though I could not remember its title.
familiar.zh: 這首歌聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起歌名。

family.en: Her family supported her decision to study abroad.
family.zh: 她的家人支持她出國留學的決定。

famous.en: The museum displays works by several famous local artists.
famous.zh: 博物館展示數位知名在地藝術家的作品。

fan.en: A small fan helped keep the classroom cool.
fan.zh: 一台小風扇幫助教室保持涼爽。

far.en: The station is not far from the school entrance.

farm.en: The farm grows vegetables without using harmful chemicals.
farm.zh: 這座農場種植蔬菜時不使用有害化學物質。

farmer.en: The farmer checked the weather before planting the seeds.
farmer.zh: 農夫在播種前先查看天氣。

fast.en: The train is fast enough to reach the city in an hour.
fast.zh: 這班火車速度夠快，一小時就能到城市。

fat.en: The nutrition label shows how much fat the food contains.
fat.zh: 營養標示顯示這份食物含有多少脂肪。

father.en: Her father helped her repair the old bicycle.
father.zh: 她的父親幫她修理舊腳踏車。

fault.en: The technician found a fault in the electrical system.
fault.zh: 技師在電力系統中發現了一個故障。

favor.en: Could you do me a favor and carry these books?
favor.zh: 你可以幫我一個忙，拿這些書嗎？

favorite.en: Science is her favorite subject because she enjoys experiments.
favorite.zh: 自然科是她最喜歡的科目，因為她喜歡做實驗。

fear.en: Practice can reduce the fear of speaking in front of others.
fear.zh: 練習可以減少在眾人面前說話的恐懼。

feasible.en: The team chose a feasible plan that fit the available time.
feasible.zh: 團隊選擇了一個符合現有時間的可行計畫。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline dictionary.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線字典。

fee.en: The museum charges a small entrance fee on weekends.
fee.zh: 博物館週末會收取少額入場費。

feeble.en: The feeble signal became stronger after the antenna was adjusted.
feeble.zh: 調整天線後，微弱的訊號變得更強。

feed.en: Please do not feed the animals without permission.
feed.zh: 沒有許可請不要餵食動物。

feel.en: Most students feel more confident after enough practice.
feel.zh: 大多數學生充分練習後會更有自信。

feeling.en: She described the feeling of relief after finishing the exam.
feeling.zh: 她描述了考完試後如釋重負的感覺。

female.en: The study included an equal number of male and female participants.
female.zh: 這項研究包含相同人數的男性與女性參與者。

fence.en: A tall fence surrounds the school garden.
fence.zh: 一座高圍欄圍住了學校花園。

festival.en: The school festival includes performances, games, and food stalls.
festival.zh: 校慶包含表演、遊戲和美食攤位。

few.en: Only a few students finished the challenge on their first attempt.
few.zh: 只有少數學生第一次嘗試就完成挑戰。

field.en: The students collected soil samples from a nearby field.
field.zh: 學生從附近田地採集土壤樣本。

fight.en: The two characters fight at first but later become friends.
fight.zh: 兩個角色一開始爭鬥，後來卻成為朋友。

figure.en: The figure shows how the system changes over time.
figure.zh: 這張圖顯示系統如何隨時間改變。

file.en: Please save the file before turning off the computer.
file.zh: 關閉電腦前請先儲存檔案。

fill.en: Please fill the bottle with clean water before the trip.
fill.zh: 出發前請把瓶子裝滿乾淨的水。

film.en: The class watched a short film about ocean conservation.
film.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋保育的短片。

final.en: The final question requires students to explain their reasoning.
final.zh: 最後一題要求學生解釋推理過程。

finally.en: After several revisions, the report was finally ready to submit.
finally.zh: 經過多次修改後，報告終於可以提交了。

finance.en: The course introduces basic ideas about personal finance and saving.
finance.zh: 這門課介紹個人理財與儲蓄的基本概念。

financial.en: The family created a financial plan before making the large purchase.
financial.zh: 這個家庭在進行大筆消費前先制定財務計畫。

find.en: You can find the answer by comparing the two paragraphs.
find.zh: 你可以比較這兩段來找到答案。

fine.en: The weather should be fine for tomorrow's outdoor activity.
fine.zh: 明天的戶外活動天氣應該不錯。

finger.en: He injured his finger while moving a heavy box.
finger.zh: 他搬重箱子時弄傷了手指。

finish.en: Please finish the first section before moving to the next one.
finish.zh: 請完成第一部分後再進入下一部分。

finite.en: The project has a finite amount of time and money available.
finite.zh: 這項專題可使用的時間與經費都是有限的。

fire.en: The fire alarm sounded during the morning class.
fire.zh: 早上上課時火警警報響了。

firm.en: The school has a firm rule against cheating on tests.
firm.zh: 學校對考試作弊有嚴格規定。

first.en: Read the instructions first before answering any questions.
first.zh: 回答任何問題前請先閱讀說明。

fish.en: The river contains several species of freshwater fish.
fish.zh: 這條河裡有數種淡水魚。

fit.en: This schedule should fit most students' study routines.
fit.zh: 這個時間表應該能配合大多數學生的讀書作息。

fix.en: The technician came to fix the broken projector.
fix.zh: 技師來修理故障的投影機。

flag.en: The flag was raised before the ceremony began.
flag.zh: 典禮開始前旗幟被升起。

flat.en: The road remains flat for several kilometers after the bridge.
flat.zh: 過橋後道路有好幾公里都很平坦。

flight.en: Our flight was delayed because of strong winds.
flight.zh: 我們的班機因強風而延誤。

floor.en: The science laboratory is on the third floor.
floor.zh: 自然科實驗室位於三樓。

flow.en: The diagram shows how water can flow through the system.
flow.zh: 這張圖示顯示水如何流經系統。

flower.en: The flower opened fully after several sunny days.
flower.zh: 經過幾個晴天後，這朵花完全綻放。

fly.en: Some birds fly thousands of kilometers during seasonal migration.
fly.zh: 有些鳥類季節遷徙時會飛行數千公里。

focus.en: Please focus on the main question when writing your answer.
focus.zh: 寫答案時請聚焦在主要問題上。

follow.en: Please follow the safety instructions during the experiment.
follow.zh: 實驗進行時請遵守安全說明。

food.en: The event provides food and drinks for all participants.
food.zh: 這場活動為所有參與者提供餐點和飲料。

foot.en: He hurt his foot while running on the wet field.
foot.zh: 他在濕滑的球場跑步時傷了腳。

football.en: The football team practices every Tuesday and Thursday.
football.zh: 足球隊每星期二和星期四練習。

for.en: This guide is designed for students preparing for the exam.
for.zh: 這份指南是為準備考試的學生設計的。

foreign.en: Learning a foreign language can broaden your view of the world.
foreign.zh: 學習外語可以拓展你對世界的看法。

forest.en: The forest provides habitat for many plants and animals.
forest.zh: 森林為許多動植物提供棲地。

forget.en: Do not forget to bring your student card tomorrow.
forget.zh: 明天不要忘記帶學生證。

form.en: Please complete the form and return it by Friday.
form.zh: 請填好表格並在星期五前繳回。

formal.en: Students wore formal clothes for the graduation ceremony.
formal.zh: 學生穿著正式服裝參加畢業典禮。

former.en: A former student returned to share advice about university life.
former.zh: 一位校友回來分享大學生活的建議。

formidable.en: The final project seemed formidable until the tasks were divided into smaller steps.
formidable.zh: 期末專題原本看似艱鉅，直到任務被拆成較小步驟。

formulate.en: Students formulate a hypothesis before beginning the experiment.
formulate.zh: 學生在開始實驗前先提出假設。

fortune.en: Good preparation often matters more than fortune in an important competition.
fortune.zh: 在重要比賽中，充分準備往往比運氣更重要。

forward.en: Please move forward carefully until you reach the marked line.
forward.zh: 請小心往前移動，直到到達標示線。

foster.en: Group discussion can foster curiosity and stronger communication skills.
foster.zh: 小組討論可以培養好奇心與更好的溝通能力。

foundation.en: Basic reading skills provide a strong foundation for later learning.
foundation.zh: 基本閱讀能力為後續學習建立穩固基礎。

fragile.en: The fragile model must be carried carefully between classrooms.
fragile.zh: 這個易碎模型在教室之間搬運時必須小心。

framework.en: The teacher provided a simple framework for organizing the essay.
framework.zh: 老師提供了一個簡單架構來整理文章。

free.en: The museum offers free admission to students on Wednesdays.
free.zh: 博物館星期三對學生免費開放。

freedom.en: The discussion focused on the balance between freedom and responsibility.
freedom.zh: 討論聚焦在自由與責任之間的平衡。

fresh.en: The market sells fresh fruit and vegetables every morning.
fresh.zh: 市場每天早上販售新鮮蔬果。

friend.en: A good friend can offer support during difficult times.
friend.zh: 好朋友能在困難時提供支持。

friendly.en: The staff were friendly and answered all our questions.
friendly.zh: 工作人員很友善，回答了我們所有問題。

frighten.en: Sudden loud noises can frighten animals in the area.
frighten.zh: 突然的巨大聲響可能會嚇到附近的動物。

from.en: Students from different classes worked together on the project.
from.zh: 來自不同班級的學生一起完成這項專題。

front.en: Please write your name on the front of the worksheet.
front.zh: 請把名字寫在學習單正面。

fruit.en: Fresh fruit is available in the school cafeteria every day.
fruit.zh: 學校餐廳每天都有新鮮水果。

frustrate.en: Unclear instructions can frustrate students during a difficult assignment.
frustrate.zh: 不清楚的指示可能讓學生在困難作業中感到挫折。

full.en: The classroom was full before the lecture even started.
full.zh: 講座開始前教室就已經坐滿了。

fun.en: The activity was fun and also helped us learn new words.
fun.zh: 這項活動很有趣，也幫助我們學習新單字。

function.en: The teacher explained the function of each part of the machine.
function.zh: 老師說明機器每個零件的功能。

fund.en: The school created a fund to support students with financial needs.
fund.zh: 學校設立基金幫助有經濟需求的學生。

fundamental.en: Clear communication is fundamental to successful teamwork in any project.
fundamental.zh: 清楚溝通是任何專案成功合作的基本要素。

furthermore.en: The plan saves money; furthermore, it reduces energy use.
furthermore.zh: 這項計畫能省錢；此外，也能減少能源使用。

future.en: She hopes to work in environmental science in the future.
future.zh: 她希望未來從事環境科學相關工作。

gain.en: Students can gain confidence by practicing short presentations regularly.
gain.zh: 學生可以透過規律練習短講來建立自信。

game.en: The final game attracted a large crowd to the stadium.
game.zh: 決賽吸引大批觀眾到體育場。

gap.en: The study found a clear gap between the two groups.
gap.zh: 這項研究發現兩組之間有明顯差距。

garage.en: The bicycles are stored in the garage behind the house.
garage.zh: 腳踏車存放在房子後方的車庫裡。

garden.en: Students planted herbs in a small garden beside the classroom.
garden.zh: 學生在教室旁的小花園種了香草。

gas.en: The experiment measures how quickly the gas expands when heated.
gas.zh: 這個實驗測量氣體受熱時膨脹的速度。

gate.en: The school gate opens at seven every morning.
gate.zh: 校門每天早上七點開啟。

gather.en: We gather information from several sources before writing the report.
gather.zh: 我們在寫報告前會從多個來源蒐集資訊。

gender.en: The survey compared study habits without making assumptions about gender.
gender.zh: 這份調查比較學習習慣，並未對性別做預設。

general.en: The teacher gave a general overview before discussing the details.
general.zh: 老師先做整體概述，再討論細節。

generate.en: The new system can generate a summary from the collected data.
generate.zh: 新系統可以根據蒐集的資料產生摘要。

generation.en: Each generation develops its own habits for using technology.
generation.zh: 每一代人都會形成自己的科技使用習慣。

generous.en: She was generous enough to share her notes with the whole group.
generous.zh: 她很大方地把筆記分享給整個小組。

genetic.en: The article explains how genetic information can influence certain traits.
genetic.zh: 這篇文章說明遺傳資訊如何影響某些特徵。

gentle.en: A gentle breeze made the afternoon walk more comfortable.
gentle.zh: 柔和的微風讓午後散步更舒服。

genuine.en: The researcher looked for genuine patterns rather than random differences.
genuine.zh: 研究人員尋找真正的規律，而不是隨機差異。

geography.en: Geography helps students understand how people interact with different environments.
geography.zh: 地理幫助學生了解人類如何與不同環境互動。

gesture.en: A simple gesture can sometimes communicate more than words.
gesture.zh: 一個簡單手勢有時比言語傳達得更多。

get.en: Students get better at writing when they practice regularly.
get.zh: 學生規律練習後，寫作能力會變得更好。

gift.en: The class prepared a small gift for the retiring teacher.
gift.zh: 全班為即將退休的老師準備了一份小禮物。

girl.en: The girl asked a thoughtful question during the science lesson.
girl.zh: 那個女孩在自然課提出了一個有深度的問題。

give.en: Please give one reason to support your answer.
give.zh: 請提供一個理由來支持你的答案。

glad.en: I am glad that we finished the project before the deadline.
glad.zh: 我很高興我們在期限前完成了專題。

glass.en: The laboratory uses thick glass containers for this experiment.
glass.zh: 實驗室在這項實驗中使用厚玻璃容器。

global.en: Climate change is a global issue that affects every region.
global.zh: 氣候變遷是影響各地區的全球性議題。

glove.en: Wear a glove when handling materials that may irritate the skin.
glove.zh: 處理可能刺激皮膚的材料時要戴手套。

go.en: We plan to go to the museum after lunch.
go.zh: 我們計畫午餐後去博物館。

goal.en: Setting a clear goal can make study plans more effective.
goal.zh: 設定明確目標能讓讀書計畫更有效。

god.en: The novel describes how people once believed each god controlled part of nature.
god.zh: 這部小說描述古人如何相信每位神祇掌管自然的一部分。

gold.en: The museum displayed a small gold object from ancient times.
gold.zh: 博物館展示了一件古代的小型金製品。

good.en: Good preparation can reduce stress before an important exam.
good.zh: 充分準備可以減少重要考試前的壓力。

government.en: The government announced new measures to improve public transportation.
government.zh: 政府宣布了改善大眾運輸的新措施。

grade.en: Her grade improved after she changed her study habits.
grade.zh: 她改變讀書習慣後，成績進步了。

gradual.en: The graph shows a gradual increase in temperature during the afternoon.
gradual.zh: 圖表顯示下午氣溫逐漸上升。

graduate.en: She hopes to graduate with strong skills in science and English.
graduate.zh: 她希望畢業時具備扎實的科學與英文能力。

grain.en: Farmers store dry grain in large containers after harvest.
grain.zh: 農民收成後把乾燥穀物存放在大型容器中。

grammar.en: Good grammar helps make your writing easier to understand.
grammar.zh: 良好的文法能讓文章更容易理解。

grandfather.en: My grandfather enjoys telling stories about his school days.
grandfather.zh: 我祖父喜歡講他學生時代的故事。

grandmother.en: My grandmother taught me how to prepare this traditional dish.
grandmother.zh: 我祖母教我如何準備這道傳統料理。

grant.en: The university offered a grant to support the research project.
grant.zh: 大學提供一筆補助金支持這項研究。

grass.en: The grass grew quickly after several days of rain.
grass.zh: 連續幾天下雨後，草長得很快。

great.en: The new library is a great place for quiet study.
great.zh: 新圖書館是安靜讀書的好地方。

green.en: The school added more green spaces around the campus.
green.zh: 學校在校園周圍增加了更多綠地。

greet.en: Students stood at the entrance to greet visiting teachers.
greet.zh: 學生站在入口迎接來訪教師。

ground.en: The heavy box was placed carefully on the ground.
ground.zh: 那個沉重的箱子被小心放到地上。

group.en: Each group must present its findings to the class.
group.zh: 每個小組都必須向全班報告研究結果。

grow.en: Plants grow faster when they receive enough light and water.
grow.zh: 植物得到足夠陽光和水分時會長得更快。

growth.en: The chart shows steady growth in online learning over five years.
growth.zh: 圖表顯示線上學習在五年間穩定成長。

guarantee.en: Careful planning cannot guarantee success, but it can reduce mistakes.
guarantee.zh: 仔細規劃無法保證成功，但能減少錯誤。

guess.en: Try to guess the word's meaning from the surrounding sentence.
guess.zh: 試著從周圍句子猜出這個單字的意思。

guest.en: A guest speaker will visit our class next Monday.
guest.zh: 下星期一會有一位客座講者來我們班。

guide.en: The guide explained the history of the old building clearly.
guide.zh: 導覽員清楚介紹了這棟老建築的歷史。

guilty.en: The court found the defendant guilty after reviewing the evidence.
guilty.zh: 法院審查證據後判定被告有罪。

habit.en: Reading every day can become a useful study habit.
habit.zh: 每天閱讀可以成為有用的學習習慣。

hair.en: Her hair was still wet after swimming practice.
hair.zh: 游泳練習後，她的頭髮還是濕的。

half.en: Only half of the students finished the task on time.
half.zh: 只有一半學生準時完成任務。

hall.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main hall.
hall.zh: 畢業典禮會在大禮堂舉行。

hand.en: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
hand.zh: 如果你知道答案，請舉手。

handle.en: Students must handle laboratory equipment with great care.
handle.zh: 學生操作實驗室設備時必須非常小心。

happen.en: Unexpected problems can happen even with careful planning.
happen.zh: 即使仔細規劃，仍可能發生意外問題。

happy.en: She felt happy after completing the difficult assignment.
happy.zh: 完成困難的作業後，她感到很開心。

hard.en: The team worked hard to finish the project before Friday.
hard.zh: 團隊努力工作，在星期五前完成專題。

hardly.en: I could hardly hear the speaker because the room was noisy.
hardly.zh: 房間太吵，我幾乎聽不到講者說話。

harm.en: Too much noise can harm concentration during study.
harm.zh: 過多噪音會傷害讀書時的專注力。

harmful.en: Some chemicals are harmful if they enter the water supply.
harmful.zh: 有些化學物質若進入供水系統會造成危害。

hat.en: He wore a hat to protect himself from the strong sun.
hat.zh: 他戴帽子來避免強烈陽光直射。

hate.en: I hate wasting time when a problem can be solved simply.
hate.zh: 如果問題可以簡單解決，我很討厭浪費時間。

have.en: We have enough information to begin the next stage.
have.zh: 我們已經有足夠資訊可以開始下一階段。

he.en: He checked the final answer twice before submitting the test.
he.zh: 他交卷前把最後答案檢查了兩次。

head.en: She turned her head when someone called her name.
head.zh: 有人叫她名字時，她轉過頭去。

headline.en: The headline summarized the main point of the news article.
headline.zh: 標題概括了這篇新聞的重點。

health.en: Regular sleep is important for both physical and mental health.
health.zh: 規律睡眠對身心健康都很重要。

healthy.en: A healthy routine should include enough sleep and exercise.
healthy.zh: 健康的作息應包含充足睡眠與運動。

hear.en: Could you speak louder so everyone can hear you?
hear.zh: 你可以說大聲一點，讓每個人都聽得到嗎？

heart.en: Exercise can help keep the heart strong and healthy.
heart.zh: 運動有助於維持心臟強健與健康。

heat.en: Dark surfaces absorb more heat under direct sunlight.
heat.zh: 深色表面在陽光直射下會吸收更多熱能。

heavy.en: The heavy rain caused flooding in several low areas.
heavy.zh: 大雨造成幾個低窪地區淹水。

height.en: The students measured the height of each plant every week.
height.zh: 學生每週測量每株植物的高度。

help.en: Clear notes can help you review more efficiently before exams.
help.zh: 清楚的筆記能幫助你在考前更有效率地複習。

helpful.en: The teacher gave helpful feedback on my first draft.
helpful.zh: 老師針對我的初稿提供了有幫助的回饋。

her.en: The teacher returned her report with several useful comments.
her.zh: 老師把她的報告退回，並附上幾則實用評語。

here.en: Please write your name here before submitting the form.
here.zh: 提交表格前請在這裡寫上你的名字。

hesitate.en: Do not hesitate to ask questions when the instructions are unclear.
hesitate.zh: 當說明不清楚時，不要猶豫，請直接提問。

hierarchy.en: The diagram shows the hierarchy of roles within the organization.
hierarchy.zh: 這張圖顯示組織內各角色的層級關係。

high.en: The mountain road reaches a high point near the old temple.
high.zh: 這條山路在老廟附近到達較高的位置。

highlight.en: Use the final paragraph to highlight the main conclusion of your report.
highlight.zh: 請用最後一段凸顯報告的主要結論。

highly.en: This study method is highly effective for reviewing vocabulary.
highly.zh: 這種讀書方法對複習單字非常有效。

hill.en: We climbed the hill to get a better view of the city.
hill.zh: 我們爬上山丘，以便看見更好的城市景色。

him.en: The teacher asked him to explain how he solved the problem.
him.zh: 老師請他說明自己如何解決這個問題。

his.en: His explanation was clear enough for everyone to understand.
his.zh: 他的解釋很清楚，大家都能理解。

historical.en: The class visited a historical building that was over one hundred years old.
historical.zh: 全班參觀了一棟有百年以上歷史的建築。

history.en: History helps us understand how societies change over time.
history.zh: 歷史幫助我們了解社會如何隨時間改變。

hit.en: The ball hit the wall and bounced back toward us.
hit.zh: 球撞到牆後彈回我們這邊。

hold.en: The school will hold a science fair next month.
hold.zh: 學校下個月會舉辦科展。

hole.en: The workers repaired a large hole in the road.
hole.zh: 工人修補了道路上的一個大洞。

holiday.en: We visited our relatives during the long holiday.
holiday.zh: 我們在長假期間拜訪了親戚。

home.en: I reviewed my notes at home after school.
home.zh: 放學後我在家複習筆記。

hope.en: We hope the weather will improve before the trip.
hope.zh: 我們希望旅行前天氣會好轉。

hospital.en: The new hospital provides emergency care around the clock.
hospital.zh: 這家新醫院全天候提供急診照護。

hot.en: The classroom became too hot after the air conditioner stopped.
hot.zh: 冷氣停止運作後，教室變得太熱。

hotel.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the train station.
hotel.zh: 這家旅館距離火車站很近，走路可到。

hour.en: The meeting lasted for nearly an hour this afternoon.
hour.zh: 今天下午的會議持續了將近一小時。

house.en: The old house was renovated without changing its original style.
house.zh: 這棟老房子在保留原本風格的情況下完成整修。

household.en: The survey asked about average household energy use each month.
household.zh: 這份調查詢問每戶家庭每月的平均能源使用量。

how.en: The experiment shows how temperature affects the reaction speed.
how.zh: 這個實驗顯示溫度如何影響反應速度。

however.en: The first method was faster; however, the second was more accurate.
however.zh: 第一種方法較快；然而，第二種較準確。

huge.en: The project required a huge amount of time and cooperation.
huge.zh: 這項專題需要大量時間與合作。

human.en: The exhibition explores how human activity affects the natural environment.
human.zh: 這場展覽探討人類活動如何影響自然環境。

humor.en: A little humor can make a presentation more enjoyable for the audience.
humor.zh: 一點幽默可以讓報告對觀眾來說更有趣。

hundred.en: More than one hundred students joined the school event.
hundred.zh: 超過一百名學生參加了學校活動。

hunger.en: The charity raises money to reduce hunger in low-income communities.
hunger.zh: 這個慈善組織募款以減少低收入社區的飢餓問題。

hungry.en: I felt hungry after practicing basketball for two hours.
hungry.zh: 打了兩小時籃球後，我覺得很餓。

hunt.en: The students had to hunt for reliable sources before writing the report.
hunt.zh: 學生在寫報告前必須尋找可靠資料來源。

hurry.en: There is no need to hurry if we follow the schedule.
hurry.zh: 只要照著行程走，就不需要急。

hurt.en: She hurt her knee while running during sports practice.
hurt.zh: 她在體育練習跑步時傷到膝蓋。

hypothesis.en: The experiment was designed to test the students' original hypothesis.
hypothesis.zh: 這項實驗是為了驗證學生原先的假設。

ice.en: The ice melted quickly after we placed it in the sun.
ice.zh: 我們把冰放到陽光下後，它很快就融化了。

idea.en: Her idea helped the group solve the problem more efficiently.
idea.zh: 她的想法幫助小組更有效率地解決問題。

ideal.en: A quiet room is ideal for tasks that require deep concentration.
ideal.zh: 安靜的房間很適合需要高度專注的工作。

identify.en: Researchers identify several factors that may affect student performance.
identify.zh: 研究人員找出幾個可能影響學生表現的因素。

identity.en: The website asks users to confirm their identity before changing passwords.
identity.zh: 網站要求使用者在更改密碼前確認身分。

ignore.en: Do not ignore small errors when checking your final report.
ignore.zh: 檢查最後報告時，不要忽略小錯誤。

ill.en: She stayed home because she felt ill in the morning.
ill.zh: 她早上覺得身體不舒服，所以待在家裡。

illustrate.en: The chart helps illustrate how the population changed over time.
illustrate.zh: 這張圖表有助於說明人口如何隨時間變化。

illustration.en: The textbook includes an illustration of the human heart.
illustration.zh: 課本中有一張人體心臟的插圖。

image.en: The image shows how the coastline changed over several decades.
image.zh: 這張影像顯示海岸線在數十年間如何改變。

imagine.en: Imagine how different school would be without computers or the internet.
imagine.zh: 想像一下，如果沒有電腦或網路，學校會有多麼不同。

immediate.en: The school took immediate action after the water pipe broke.
immediate.zh: 水管破裂後，學校立刻採取行動。

impact.en: Regular exercise can have a positive impact on concentration.
impact.zh: 規律運動可以對專注力產生正面影響。

implement.en: The school plans to implement the new recycling program next semester.
implement.zh: 學校計畫下學期實施新的回收方案。

implicit.en: The passage contains an implicit message about personal responsibility.
implicit.zh: 這篇文章包含一個關於個人責任的隱含訊息。

imply.en: The results may imply that sleep affects learning efficiency.
imply.zh: 這些結果可能暗示睡眠會影響學習效率。

important.en: It is important to check the source before trusting information online.
important.zh: 相信網路資訊前先查證來源很重要。

impose.en: The school may impose a limit on the number of participants.
impose.zh: 學校可能會限制參加人數。

impress.en: Her clear explanation managed to impress the entire class.
impress.zh: 她清楚的解釋讓全班留下深刻印象。

improve.en: Daily reading can improve both vocabulary and reading speed.
improve.zh: 每天閱讀可以提升字彙量與閱讀速度。

improvement.en: The second draft showed clear improvement in organization and grammar.
improvement.zh: 第二版草稿在組織與文法方面有明顯進步。

in.en: Please place the completed worksheet in the blue folder.
in.zh: 請把完成的學習單放進藍色資料夾。

incentive.en: The school offered an incentive for classes that reduced waste.
incentive.zh: 學校為減少垃圾的班級提供獎勵。

incident.en: The school reviewed the incident before changing its safety rules.
incident.zh: 學校在修改安全規定前檢討了這起事件。

incline.en: The road begins to incline sharply near the top of the hill.
incline.zh: 道路接近山頂時開始明顯上坡。

include.en: The final report should include at least two reliable sources.
include.zh: 最後報告應至少包含兩個可靠來源。

income.en: The survey compares household income across different regions.
income.zh: 這份調查比較不同地區的家庭收入。

incorporate.en: The revised report will incorporate feedback from both teachers.
incorporate.zh: 修訂後的報告會納入兩位老師的回饋。

increase.en: Better lighting can increase comfort in the study area.
increase.zh: 更好的照明可以提升讀書區的舒適度。

incur.en: Late changes may incur additional costs for the event organizers.
incur.zh: 臨時更動可能會讓活動主辦單位產生額外費用。

indeed.en: The task was indeed difficult, but the team completed it successfully.
indeed.zh: 這項任務確實很困難，但團隊仍成功完成。

independent.en: Students completed an independent research project during the semester.
independent.zh: 學生在學期中完成一項獨立研究專題。

index.en: Use the index at the back of the book to find the topic.
index.zh: 請使用書後的索引找到這個主題。

indicate.en: The red marks indicate which answers need to be corrected.
indicate.zh: 紅色記號指出哪些答案需要修正。

indispensable.en: Reliable data are indispensable when making a strong scientific conclusion.
indispensable.zh: 要做出有力的科學結論，可靠資料不可或缺。

individual.en: Each individual must submit a separate copy of the worksheet.
individual.zh: 每個人都必須各自繳交一份學習單。

induce.en: Bright light can induce faster growth in some young plants.
induce.zh: 強光可能促使某些幼苗生長得更快。

industry.en: The local industry has changed greatly because of new technology.
industry.zh: 當地產業因新科技而有很大改變。

inevitable.en: Some mistakes are inevitable when people learn a new skill.
inevitable.zh: 人們學習新技能時，有些錯誤是難免的。

infer.en: Readers can infer the character's feelings from her actions.
infer.zh: 讀者可以從角色的行動推測她的感受。

inferior.en: The cheaper material proved inferior during the durability test.
inferior.zh: 較便宜的材料在耐用度測試中表現較差。

influence.en: Friends can influence the way teenagers choose their hobbies.
influence.zh: 朋友可能影響青少年選擇興趣的方式。

inform.en: Please inform the teacher if you cannot attend the meeting.
inform.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請通知老師。

information.en: Reliable information is important when making a research conclusion.
information.zh: 做研究結論時，可靠資訊非常重要。

ingredient.en: Fresh vegetables are an important ingredient in this dish.
ingredient.zh: 新鮮蔬菜是這道料理的重要食材。

inherent.en: Every method has inherent limits that researchers need to consider.
inherent.zh: 每種方法都有研究人員需要考量的固有限制。

initial.en: The initial plan was revised after the team received feedback.
initial.zh: 團隊收到回饋後修改了原先的計畫。

initiative.en: The recycling initiative encouraged students to reduce plastic waste.
initiative.zh: 這項回收倡議鼓勵學生減少塑膠垃圾。

injure.en: Poor technique can injure players during intense sports practice.
injure.zh: 不正確的技巧可能使球員在激烈運動練習中受傷。

injury.en: He returned to practice after recovering from a knee injury.
injury.zh: 膝傷康復後，他回到練習場。

inner.en: The inner part of the device contains several small sensors.
inner.zh: 這個裝置內部包含數個小型感測器。

innovation.en: Innovation in technology often changes how people study and work.
innovation.zh: 科技創新經常改變人們學習與工作的方式。

innovative.en: The students proposed an innovative way to reduce waste at school.
innovative.zh: 學生提出一個創新的方式來減少校園垃圾。

insect.en: The students observed an insect through a magnifying glass.
insect.zh: 學生透過放大鏡觀察一隻昆蟲。

inside.en: Please wait inside the building until the rain becomes lighter.
inside.zh: 請在建築物內等待，直到雨勢變小。

inspect.en: Technicians inspect the equipment before students use it.
inspect.zh: 技術人員會在學生使用設備前先進行檢查。

inspire.en: A good teacher can inspire students to explore new ideas.
inspire.zh: 好老師能啟發學生探索新的想法。

install.en: Workers will install new lights in the library this weekend.
install.zh: 工人這個週末會在圖書館安裝新燈具。

instance.en: For instance, public transportation can reduce traffic in cities.
instance.zh: 例如，大眾運輸可以減少城市交通流量。

instead.en: We took the train instead because the highway was crowded.
instead.zh: 因為高速公路很塞，我們改搭火車。

institution.en: The institution provides scholarships for students with strong academic records.
institution.zh: 該機構為學業表現優秀的學生提供獎學金。

instruction.en: Read each instruction carefully before starting the experiment.
instruction.zh: 開始實驗前請仔細閱讀每一項指示。

instrument.en: The laboratory uses a special instrument to measure air pressure.
instrument.zh: 實驗室使用特殊儀器測量氣壓。

insurance.en: Travel insurance can help cover unexpected costs during a trip.
insurance.zh: 旅遊保險可以協助負擔旅途中意外產生的費用。

integrate.en: The project will integrate science, technology, and design skills.
integrate.zh: 這項專題將整合科學、科技與設計能力。

intelligence.en: The discussion focused on how artificial intelligence may change education.
intelligence.zh: 討論著重於人工智慧可能如何改變教育。

intelligent.en: The system uses intelligent software to organize large amounts of data.
intelligent.zh: 這套系統使用智慧軟體整理大量資料。

intend.en: We intend to finish the project before the end of May.
intend.zh: 我們打算在五月底前完成專題。

intense.en: The intense discussion continued until the class period ended.
intense.zh: 激烈的討論一直持續到下課。

interact.en: Students interact with classmates while completing the group activity.
interact.zh: 學生在完成小組活動時會與同學互動。

interest.en: Her interest in science grew after visiting the museum.
interest.zh: 參觀博物館後，她對科學的興趣增加了。

interested.en: Many students are interested in learning how robots work.
interested.zh: 許多學生對了解機器人如何運作感興趣。

interesting.en: The article gives an interesting explanation of animal communication.
interesting.zh: 這篇文章對動物溝通提供了有趣的解釋。

intermediate.en: This course is designed for students at an intermediate level.
intermediate.zh: 這門課是為中等程度的學生設計的。

internal.en: The machine stopped because of an internal electrical problem.
internal.zh: 這台機器因內部電路問題而停止運作。

international.en: The school joined an international exchange program with several partner schools.
international.zh: 學校加入了與數所姊妹校合作的國際交換計畫。

internet.en: The internet makes it easier to access information from many sources.
internet.zh: 網路讓人更容易取得多種來源的資訊。

interpret.en: Different readers may interpret the same story in different ways.
interpret.zh: 不同讀者可能用不同方式解讀同一個故事。

interpretation.en: Different readers may have a different interpretation of the same poem.
interpretation.zh: 不同讀者可能對同一首詩有不同解讀。

interrupt.en: Please do not interrupt while another student is presenting.
interrupt.zh: 其他同學報告時，請不要打斷。

interval.en: Students took a short break at regular interval points during practice.
interval.zh: 學生在練習過程中的固定間隔點短暫休息。

intervene.en: A teacher may intervene when a group discussion becomes unproductive.
intervene.zh: 當小組討論失去成效時，老師可能會介入。

interview.en: She prepared several questions before the interview with the scientist.
interview.zh: 她在訪問科學家前準備了幾個問題。

into.en: The class was divided into four groups for the activity.
into.zh: 全班為了活動被分成四組。

introduce.en: The teacher will introduce the new topic with a short video.
introduce.zh: 老師會用一段短影片介紹新主題。

introduction.en: The introduction explains the purpose and structure of the report.
introduction.zh: 前言說明了報告的目的與架構。

invent.en: Engineers often invent new tools to solve practical problems.
invent.zh: 工程師常發明新工具來解決實際問題。

invention.en: The invention changed how people communicated across long distances.
invention.zh: 這項發明改變了人們遠距溝通的方式。

invest.en: The company plans to invest more money in clean energy.
invest.zh: 公司計畫投入更多資金於潔淨能源。

investigate.en: The science team will investigate why the plants grew differently.
investigate.zh: 科學小組將調查植物生長不同的原因。

investment.en: Education is an important investment in a person's future.
investment.zh: 教育是對個人未來的重要投資。

invite.en: The club plans to invite a local artist to speak.
invite.zh: 社團計畫邀請一位在地藝術家來演講。

involve.en: The project will involve students from three different classes.
involve.zh: 這項專題會有三個不同班級的學生參與。

island.en: The small island is known for its clear water and coral reefs.
island.zh: 這座小島以清澈海水與珊瑚礁聞名。

isolate.en: Researchers isolate one variable to study its effect more clearly.
isolate.zh: 研究人員會隔離單一變因，以更清楚研究它的影響。

issue.en: Water shortage is an important issue in many regions.
issue.zh: 缺水是許多地區的重要議題。

item.en: Each item on the checklist should be reviewed before submission.
item.zh: 提交前應檢查清單上的每一項。

itself.en: The machine turns itself off when it becomes too hot.
itself.zh: 機器過熱時會自行關閉。

jacket.en: Bring a light jacket because the evening may become cool.
jacket.zh: 帶一件薄外套，因為晚上可能會變涼。

job.en: The volunteer job taught her how to work with different people.
job.zh: 這份志工工作讓她學會如何與不同的人合作。

join.en: Students can join the science club at the start of each semester.
join.zh: 學生可以在每學期開始時加入科學社。

journal.en: She recorded the experiment results in her science journal each day.
journal.zh: 她每天把實驗結果記錄在科學日誌中。

journey.en: The long train journey gave us time to read and rest.
journey.zh: 長途火車旅程讓我們有時間閱讀與休息。

judge.en: It is difficult to judge the result without enough evidence.
judge.zh: 沒有足夠證據時，很難判斷結果。

jump.en: The athlete practiced how to jump higher without losing balance.
jump.zh: 這名運動員練習如何跳得更高又不失去平衡。

just.en: The bus arrived just before the rain started.
just.zh: 公車正好在開始下雨前抵達。

justify.en: Students should justify each answer with evidence from the passage.
justify.zh: 學生應用文章中的證據說明每個答案的理由。

keen.en: He is keen to learn more about astronomy and space science.
keen.zh: 他很熱衷於學習更多天文與太空科學知識。

keep.en: Please keep your notes organized so they are easy to review.
keep.zh: 請把筆記整理好，方便之後複習。

key.en: Understanding the key idea makes the passage much easier to follow.
key.zh: 理解關鍵概念後，文章會容易讀懂許多。

kick.en: He gave the ball a strong kick toward the goal.

kid.en: Every kid in the group received a small notebook.
kid.zh: 小組裡每個孩子都拿到一本小筆記本。

kill.en: Extreme heat can kill young plants if they lack water.
kill.zh: 如果缺水，極端高溫可能使幼苗枯死。

kind.en: A kind comment can encourage someone who feels uncertain.
kind.zh: 一句友善的話能鼓勵感到沒自信的人。

king.en: The history book describes how the king ruled the country.
king.zh: 歷史課本描述這位國王如何統治國家。

kitchen.en: The kitchen was cleaned before the cooking activity began.
kitchen.zh: 烹飪活動開始前，廚房已經清理乾淨。

knee.en: She hurt her knee while running down the stairs.
knee.zh: 她跑下樓梯時傷到了膝蓋。

knife.en: Use the knife carefully when cutting the fruit.
knife.zh: 切水果時請小心使用刀具。

knock.en: Please knock before entering the teacher's office.
knock.zh: 進入老師辦公室前請先敲門。

know.en: It is useful to know which study methods work best for you.
know.zh: 了解哪些讀書方法最適合自己很有幫助。

knowledge.en: Background knowledge can make a difficult article easier to understand.
knowledge.zh: 背景知識能讓困難文章更容易理解。

label.en: Please label each sample clearly before starting the experiment.
label.zh: 開始實驗前請清楚標示每個樣本。

labor.en: New machines reduced the amount of manual labor required.
labor.zh: 新機器減少了所需的人工勞動量。

laboratory.en: Students must wear safety glasses inside the laboratory.
laboratory.zh: 學生在實驗室內必須戴護目鏡。

lack.en: A lack of sleep can make concentration more difficult.
lack.zh: 睡眠不足會讓專注變得更困難。

lady.en: The lady at the information desk showed us the correct direction.
lady.zh: 服務台的女士告訴我們正確方向。

lake.en: We walked around the lake before returning to the bus.
lake.zh: 我們繞湖走了一圈後才回到遊覽車。

land.en: The plane will land shortly after sunset.
land.zh: 飛機會在日落後不久降落。

landscape.en: The mountain landscape changed dramatically after the heavy rain.
landscape.zh: 大雨過後，山區景觀出現明顯變化。

language.en: Learning a new language requires regular practice and patience.
language.zh: 學習一種新語言需要規律練習與耐心。

large.en: A large number of students joined the environmental campaign.
large.zh: 很多學生參加了這項環保活動。

last.en: The final presentation will last about twenty minutes.
last.zh: 最後的報告大約會持續二十分鐘。

late.en: We arrived late because the train was delayed.
late.zh: 因為火車延誤，我們遲到了。

later.en: We can discuss the difficult question later after class.
later.zh: 我們可以下課後再討論這個難題。

latest.en: Please check the latest schedule before leaving home.
latest.zh: 出門前請確認最新時刻表。

laugh.en: The whole class began to laugh at the funny example.
laugh.zh: 全班聽到那個有趣的例子後笑了起來。

launch.en: The school will launch a new reading program next month.
launch.zh: 學校下個月將推出新的閱讀計畫。

law.en: The new law aims to improve safety on public roads.
law.zh: 這項新法律旨在提升公共道路安全。

lawyer.en: The lawyer explained the case in simple language.
lawyer.zh: 律師用簡單的語言說明這起案件。

lay.en: Please lay the papers flat on the table.

lead.en: Good planning can lead to better results and less stress.
lead.zh: 良好規劃能帶來更好的結果和更少壓力。

leader.en: A good leader listens carefully to different opinions.
leader.zh: 好的領導者會仔細聆聽不同意見。

leadership.en: The program helps students develop teamwork and leadership skills.
leadership.zh: 這項計畫幫助學生培養團隊合作與領導能力。

leaf.en: A green leaf floated slowly down from the tree.
leaf.zh: 一片綠葉從樹上慢慢飄落。

learn.en: Students learn faster when they use new words in context.
learn.zh: 學生在語境中使用新單字時學得更快。

learning.en: Online learning can be effective when students stay organized.
learning.zh: 如果學生有良好規劃，線上學習可以很有效。

least.en: Please read at least two sources before writing the report.
least.zh: 寫報告前請至少閱讀兩個資料來源。

leave.en: Please leave enough time to check your answers.
leave.zh: 請預留足夠時間檢查答案。

lecture.en: The lecture introduced several ideas about renewable energy.
lecture.zh: 這場講座介紹了幾個再生能源相關概念。

left.en: Turn left at the next corner to reach the station.
left.zh: 在下一個路口左轉就能到車站。

leg.en: He injured his leg during basketball practice.
leg.zh: 他在籃球練習時傷到了腿。

legal.en: The article explains several legal rules related to online privacy.
legal.zh: 這篇文章說明幾項與網路隱私有關的法律規定。

legend.en: The guide told us a local legend about the old bridge.
legend.zh: 導覽員告訴我們一個關於老橋的地方傳說。

legitimate.en: The teacher asked whether the website was a legitimate source of information.
legitimate.zh: 老師詢問這個網站是否為合法且可信的資訊來源。

leisure.en: Reading novels is a popular leisure activity among many students.
leisure.zh: 閱讀小說是許多學生喜愛的休閒活動。

lend.en: Could you lend me your notes after class?
lend.zh: 下課後可以借我你的筆記嗎？

length.en: The teacher asked us to measure the length of the table.
length.zh: 老師要我們測量桌子的長度。

less.en: This method uses less time while producing similar results.
less.zh: 這個方法花更少時間，卻能得到相似結果。

lesson.en: Today's lesson focuses on how to identify the main idea.
lesson.zh: 今天的課程著重於如何找出主旨。

let.en: Please let me know if the schedule changes.
let.zh: 如果行程有變，請告訴我。

letter.en: She wrote a short letter to thank her teacher.
letter.zh: 她寫了一封短信感謝老師。

level.en: This book is suitable for students at an intermediate level.
level.zh: 這本書適合中等程度的學生。

library.en: The library stays open later during exam week.
library.zh: 考試週期間圖書館會開放得比較晚。

life.en: Regular exercise can improve both health and quality of life.
life.zh: 規律運動能改善健康和生活品質。

lift.en: Please lift the box carefully because it is heavier than it looks.
lift.zh: 請小心抬這個箱子，因為它比看起來重。

light.en: Plants need enough light to grow properly.
light.zh: 植物需要足夠光線才能正常生長。

like.en: Many students like to review vocabulary before going to bed.
like.zh: 許多學生喜歡在睡前複習單字。

likely.en: Regular practice makes success more likely over time.
likely.zh: 規律練習會讓成功的機會隨時間提高。

likewise.en: The first group improved its score, and the second did likewise.
likewise.zh: 第一組提高了分數，第二組也同樣有所進步。

limit.en: The teacher set a ten-minute limit for the discussion.
limit.zh: 老師為討論設定十分鐘的時間限制。

line.en: Please draw a straight line between the two points.
line.zh: 請在兩點之間畫一條直線。

link.en: The study found a possible link between sleep and memory.
link.zh: 研究發現睡眠與記憶之間可能存在關聯。

list.en: Make a list of the main ideas before writing your summary.
list.zh: 寫摘要前先列出主要觀念。

listen.en: Students should listen carefully before answering the question.
listen.zh: 學生在回答問題前應仔細聆聽。

literature.en: The course introduces students to modern literature from several countries.
literature.zh: 這門課介紹來自多個國家的現代文學作品。

little.en: A little preparation can make a difficult task much easier.
little.zh: 一點準備就能讓困難任務容易許多。

live.en: Many people live near the river because transportation is convenient.
live.zh: 許多人住在河邊，因為交通方便。

local.en: The school bought vegetables from a local farm.
local.zh: 學校向當地農場購買蔬菜。

locate.en: Use the map to locate the river near the city center.
locate.zh: 利用地圖找出市中心附近那條河的位置。

location.en: The app can show your current location on the map.
location.zh: 這個應用程式可以在地圖上顯示你目前的位置。

lock.en: Remember to lock the classroom door before leaving.
lock.zh: 離開前記得把教室門鎖上。

logical.en: A logical argument should connect evidence clearly to its conclusion.
logical.zh: 合乎邏輯的論點應清楚連結證據與結論。

look.en: Look at the graph carefully before choosing your answer.
look.zh: 選答案前請仔細看這張圖表。

lose.en: You may lose important files if you forget to save them.
lose.zh: 如果忘記儲存，你可能會遺失重要檔案。

loss.en: The company reported a small loss during the first quarter.
loss.zh: 公司第一季出現小幅虧損。

lot.en: A lot of students attended the science fair this year.
lot.zh: 今年有很多學生參加科展。

loud.en: The music was too loud for us to concentrate.
loud.zh: 音樂太大聲，讓我們無法專心。

love.en: She developed a love of reading at an early age.
love.zh: 她從小就培養出對閱讀的喜愛。

low.en: The temperature remained low throughout the morning.
low.zh: 整個早上氣溫都維持在低點。

luck.en: Good preparation matters more than luck in most exams.
luck.zh: 在多數考試中，充分準備比運氣更重要。

lucky.en: We were lucky to catch the last train home.
lucky.zh: 我們很幸運趕上最後一班回家的火車。

lunch.en: We discussed the project during lunch in the cafeteria.
lunch.zh: 我們午餐時在餐廳討論了專題。

machine.en: The machine stops automatically if the temperature becomes too high.
machine.zh: 溫度過高時，機器會自動停止。

main.en: The main reason for the change was improved safety.
main.zh: 這項改變的主要原因是提升安全。

maintain.en: Regular maintenance helps maintain the equipment in good condition.
maintain.zh: 定期保養有助於讓設備維持良好狀態。

major.en: Traffic is a major problem in many large cities.
major.zh: 交通是許多大城市的一項主要問題。

majority.en: The majority of students supported the new library schedule.
majority.zh: 大多數學生支持新的圖書館開放時間。

make.en: Careful planning can make a difficult project easier to manage.
make.zh: 仔細規劃能讓困難的專題更容易處理。

manage.en: She learned to manage her time more effectively before exams.
manage.zh: 她學會在考前更有效管理時間。

manager.en: The manager explained the new schedule to the staff.
manager.zh: 經理向員工說明了新的排班。

manipulate.en: Students manipulate the model to observe how each part moves.
manipulate.zh: 學生操作模型來觀察各個部件如何移動。

manner.en: He answered the difficult question in a calm manner.
manner.zh: 他以冷靜的方式回答那個難題。

manufacture.en: The factory can manufacture thousands of parts each week.
manufacture.zh: 這座工廠每週可以製造數千個零件。

many.en: Many students use flashcards to review vocabulary.
many.zh: 許多學生使用單字卡複習單字。

map.en: The map shows several walking routes around the park.
map.zh: 這張地圖顯示公園周邊的幾條步行路線。

marginal.en: The second method produced only a marginal improvement in accuracy.
marginal.zh: 第二種方法在準確度上只帶來些微提升。

mark.en: Please mark the correct answer clearly on the sheet.
mark.zh: 請在答案紙上清楚標示正確答案。

market.en: The night market becomes especially busy on weekends.

material.en: This material is strong enough to support the model.
material.zh: 這種材料夠堅固，可以支撐模型。

matter.en: Small details can matter when the final score is close.
matter.zh: 當分數很接近時，小細節也可能很重要。

mature.en: A mature response considers both the problem and possible solutions.
mature.zh: 成熟的回應會同時考慮問題與可能的解決方法。

may.en: The outdoor event may be canceled if the rain continues.
may.zh: 如果雨一直下，戶外活動可能會取消。

maybe.en: Maybe we should compare the two plans again before deciding.
maybe.zh: 也許我們應該在決定前再比較一次兩個方案。

meal.en: A balanced meal should include several different kinds of food.
meal.zh: 均衡的一餐應包含多種不同食物。

mean.en: What does this expression mean in the passage?
mean.zh: 這個表達方式在文章中是什麼意思？

meaning.en: Context often helps readers understand the meaning of an unfamiliar word.
meaning.zh: 語境常能幫助讀者理解陌生單字的意思。

measure.en: Students measure the temperature at the same time each day.
measure.zh: 學生每天在同一時間測量溫度。

mechanism.en: The lesson explains the basic mechanism behind the water filter.
mechanism.zh: 這堂課說明濾水器背後的基本運作機制。

media.en: Social media can spread information very quickly among young people.
media.zh: 社群媒體可以在年輕人之間快速傳播資訊。

mediate.en: A teacher helped mediate the disagreement between the two groups.
mediate.zh: 老師協助調解兩組之間的意見分歧。

medical.en: The school invited a medical expert to speak about public health.
medical.zh: 學校邀請一位醫療專家談公共衛生。

medicine.en: Take the medicine exactly as the doctor instructed.
medicine.zh: 請完全按照醫師指示服用藥物。

meet.en: We will meet in front of the library after class.
meet.zh: 下課後我們會在圖書館前碰面。

meeting.en: The meeting ended early because everyone agreed on the plan.
meeting.zh: 因為大家都同意這個計畫，會議提早結束。

member.en: Every member of the team has a different responsibility.
member.zh: 團隊中的每位成員都有不同責任。

memory.en: Regular review can improve long-term memory of new vocabulary.
memory.zh: 規律複習能提升新單字的長期記憶。

message.en: I sent a short message to confirm the meeting time.
message.zh: 我傳了一則簡短訊息確認會議時間。

method.en: This method helps students organize complex information more clearly.
method.zh: 這種方法能幫助學生更清楚整理複雜資訊。

middle.en: The school is located in the middle of the neighborhood.
middle.zh: 學校位於這個社區的中央。

mile.en: The trail continues for another mile beyond the bridge.
mile.zh: 這條步道過橋後還延伸一英里。

milk.en: She drank a glass of milk with breakfast.
milk.zh: 她早餐時喝了一杯牛奶。

mind.en: Keep an open mind when listening to different opinions.
mind.zh: 聽取不同意見時要保持開放的心態。

minimal.en: The final design uses a minimal amount of material.
minimal.zh: 最後的設計使用最少量的材料。

minimize.en: Careful planning can minimize errors during the final experiment.
minimize.zh: 仔細規劃可以把最後實驗中的錯誤降到最低。

minor.en: The report found only a minor difference between the two groups.
minor.zh: 報告發現兩組之間只有小幅差異。

minute.en: Please wait one minute while I check the schedule.
minute.zh: 請等一分鐘，我確認一下行程。

miss.en: You may miss important details if you read too quickly.
miss.zh: 如果讀得太快，你可能會漏掉重要細節。

mistake.en: A small mistake can change the final answer completely.
mistake.zh: 一個小錯誤可能完全改變最後答案。

model.en: The students built a model to explain how the system works.
model.zh: 學生做了一個模型來說明系統如何運作。

moderate.en: A moderate amount of background noise did not affect the results.
moderate.zh: 適量的背景噪音並沒有影響結果。

modern.en: Modern technology has changed the way people communicate.
modern.zh: 現代科技改變了人們溝通的方式。

modify.en: The group decided to modify the design after the first test.
modify.zh: 第一次測試後，小組決定修改設計。

moment.en: Please wait a moment while the file finishes loading.
moment.zh: 請稍等一下，讓檔案載入完成。

money.en: She saved enough money to buy a new laptop.
money.zh: 她存了足夠的錢買一台新筆電。

monitor.en: Researchers monitor the river level after periods of heavy rain.
monitor.zh: 研究人員在豪雨後監測河川水位。

month.en: The project must be completed by the end of this month.
month.zh: 這項專題必須在這個月底前完成。

more.en: We need more evidence before making a final decision.
more.zh: 做最後決定前，我們需要更多證據。

morning.en: I usually review vocabulary for ten minutes every morning.
morning.zh: 我通常每天早上複習十分鐘單字。

most.en: Most students finished the assignment before the deadline.
most.zh: 大多數學生都在期限前完成了作業。

mother.en: My mother helped me prepare lunch for the trip.
mother.zh: 我媽媽幫我準備旅程的午餐。

motive.en: The story gradually reveals the main character's motive for leaving.
motive.zh: 故事逐漸揭示主角離開的動機。

mountain.en: The mountain trail becomes slippery after heavy rain.
mountain.zh: 大雨後山徑會變得濕滑。

move.en: Please move your chair closer to the table.

movie.en: The class watched a short movie about ocean conservation.
movie.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋保育的短片。

much.en: This method requires much less time than the original one.
much.zh: 這個方法比原本的方法省下很多時間。

multiple.en: The project uses multiple sources to compare different viewpoints.
multiple.zh: 這項專題使用多個來源比較不同觀點。

music.en: Soft music can help some students relax while studying.
music.zh: 輕柔音樂能幫助一些學生在讀書時放鬆。

must.en: Students must follow the safety rules in the laboratory.
must.zh: 學生在實驗室必須遵守安全規則。

mutual.en: Successful teamwork depends on mutual respect among all group members.
mutual.zh: 成功的團隊合作有賴所有成員彼此尊重。

my.en: I wrote my name at the top of the page.
my.zh: 我把名字寫在頁面上方。

name.en: Please write your full name at the top of the form.
name.zh: 請在表格上方寫下你的全名。

narrow.en: The path became narrow as we approached the mountain village.
narrow.zh: 我們接近山村時，小路變得很狹窄。

nation.en: Each nation develops policies based on its own needs.
nation.zh: 每個國家都會依自己的需求制定政策。

national.en: The national museum attracts visitors from many different regions.
national.zh: 這座國家博物館吸引來自許多地區的遊客。

native.en: She is a native speaker who also teaches English grammar.
native.zh: 她是母語人士，也教授英文文法。

natural.en: The park is known for its natural scenery and clean air.
natural.zh: 這座公園以自然景觀與清新空氣聞名。

nature.en: Spending time in nature can help people relax and focus.
nature.zh: 接觸大自然能幫助人放鬆並專注。

near.en: A small bookstore opened near the station last month.
near.zh: 上個月車站附近開了一家小書店。

nearby.en: We found a nearby café where we could finish our homework.
nearby.zh: 我們找到附近一家可以完成作業的咖啡店。

nearly.en: Nearly all the students completed the survey on time.
nearly.zh: 幾乎所有學生都準時完成問卷。

necessary.en: Careful preparation is necessary for a successful science experiment.
necessary.zh: 仔細準備是成功完成科學實驗的必要條件。

neck.en: He stretched his neck after sitting at the desk for hours.
neck.zh: 坐在書桌前好幾個小時後，他伸展了頸部。

need.en: Students need enough sleep to stay focused during class.
need.zh: 學生需要充足睡眠，才能在課堂上保持專注。

negative.en: Too much negative feedback can reduce a student's confidence.
negative.zh: 過多負面回饋可能降低學生的自信。

negotiate.en: Both sides agreed to negotiate a new schedule before the semester began.
negotiate.zh: 雙方同意在學期開始前協商新的時程。

negotiation.en: The negotiation continued until both groups accepted the final plan.
negotiation.zh: 協商持續到兩組都接受最後方案為止。

neighbor.en: Our neighbor helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
neighbor.zh: 鄰居幫我們把箱子搬上樓。

neighborhood.en: The neighborhood has changed a lot since the new station opened.
neighborhood.zh: 新車站開放後，這個社區改變了很多。

neither.en: Neither answer is correct, so read the question again.
neither.zh: 兩個答案都不正確，所以請再讀一次題目。

nervous.en: She felt nervous before giving her first speech in English.
nervous.zh: 第一次用英文演講前，她感到很緊張。

network.en: The school network allows students to access online learning materials.
network.zh: 學校網路讓學生可以存取線上學習資料。

neutral.en: The teacher remained neutral while students discussed the controversial issue.
neutral.zh: 學生討論具爭議的議題時，老師保持中立。

never.en: I never submit an assignment before checking it carefully.
never.zh: 我從不在仔細檢查前交作業。

nevertheless.en: The weather was poor; nevertheless, the outdoor event continued as planned.
nevertheless.zh: 天氣不好；儘管如此，戶外活動仍按計畫進行。

new.en: The teacher introduced a new method for reviewing vocabulary.
new.zh: 老師介紹了一種複習單字的新方法。

news.en: We checked the news to learn more about the storm.
news.zh: 我們查看新聞以了解更多暴風雨資訊。

newspaper.en: The newspaper published an article about local environmental problems.
newspaper.zh: 這家報紙刊登了一篇關於當地環境問題的文章。

next.en: Please read the next section before tomorrow's class.
next.zh: 請在明天上課前讀完下一部分。

nice.en: It was nice to study outside on such a cool afternoon.
nice.zh: 在這麼涼爽的午後到戶外讀書很舒服。

night.en: The temperature dropped quickly after night fell.

no.en: There is no simple answer to every social problem.
no.zh: 不是每個社會問題都有簡單答案。

nobody.en: Nobody knew the correct answer until the teacher explained it.
nobody.zh: 直到老師解釋前，沒有人知道正確答案。

noise.en: Traffic noise made it difficult to concentrate on reading.
noise.zh: 交通噪音讓人很難專心閱讀。

none.en: None of the computers worked after the power failure.
none.zh: 停電後，所有電腦都無法使用。

normal.en: It is normal to feel tired after a long day of study.
normal.zh: 讀書一整天後感到疲累是正常的。

north.en: The hikers continued north until they reached the river.
north.zh: 登山客一路往北走，直到抵達河邊。

northern.en: The northern part of the island receives more rain in winter.
northern.zh: 島嶼北部在冬天有較多降雨。

nose.en: The cold air made my nose feel uncomfortable.
nose.zh: 冷空氣讓我的鼻子感到不舒服。

not.en: This method is not difficult once you understand the basic steps.
not.zh: 一旦了解基本步驟，這個方法其實不難。

notable.en: The report highlights a notable improvement in reading comprehension scores.
notable.zh: 這份報告強調閱讀理解成績有明顯進步。

note.en: Please make a note of the homework deadline in your planner.
note.zh: 請把作業截止日期記在行事曆裡。

nothing.en: Nothing changed after we repeated the experiment under the same conditions.
nothing.zh: 在相同條件下重做實驗後，沒有任何變化。

notice.en: Did you notice the difference between the two graphs?
notice.zh: 你有注意到這兩張圖表之間的差異嗎？

notion.en: The lesson challenged the common notion that faster is always better.
notion.zh: 這堂課挑戰了速度越快就一定越好的常見觀念。

novel.en: The class read a short novel about friendship and responsibility.
novel.zh: 全班閱讀了一本關於友誼與責任的短篇小說。

now.en: We have enough information to make a decision now.
now.zh: 我們現在已經有足夠資訊可以做決定。

nowadays.en: Nowadays, many students use digital tools for studying.
nowadays.zh: 現在許多學生會使用數位工具來學習。

number.en: Please write your student number beside your name.
number.zh: 請在姓名旁寫上你的學號。

numerous.en: Numerous studies have examined how sleep affects learning and memory.
numerous.zh: 許多研究探討了睡眠如何影響學習與記憶。

nurse.en: The nurse checked his temperature before calling the doctor.
nurse.zh: 護理師在叫醫師前先量了他的體溫。

object.en: Each object in the experiment was weighed carefully.
object.zh: 實驗中的每個物體都被仔細秤重。

objective.en: Our objective is to reduce unnecessary energy use at school.
objective.zh: 我們的目標是減少校園中不必要的能源使用。

obligation.en: Students have an obligation to follow the laboratory safety rules.
obligation.zh: 學生有義務遵守實驗室安全規定。

oblige.en: School rules oblige students to wear safety glasses in the laboratory.
oblige.zh: 校規要求學生在實驗室配戴護目鏡。

observe.en: Students observe the plants every day and record any changes.
observe.zh: 學生每天觀察植物並記錄任何變化。

obtain.en: Researchers must obtain reliable data before drawing a conclusion.
obtain.zh: 研究人員在下結論前必須取得可靠資料。

obvious.en: It became obvious that the first method was less efficient.
obvious.zh: 很明顯第一種方法效率較低。

occasion.en: On this occasion, the school invited several former students to speak.
occasion.zh: 這次學校邀請了幾位校友來演講。

occupy.en: Large shelves occupy most of the space along the back wall.
occupy.zh: 大型書架占據了後牆大部分空間。

occur.en: Small errors can occur when measurements are recorded too quickly.
occur.zh: 測量數據記錄得太快時，可能會出現小錯誤。

ocean.en: Plastic waste can travel long distances across the ocean.
ocean.zh: 塑膠垃圾可能漂過海洋很長的距離。

odd.en: The machine made an odd sound before it suddenly stopped.
odd.zh: 那台機器突然停止前發出奇怪的聲音。

of.en: The results of the experiment were recorded in a table.
of.zh: 實驗結果被記錄在表格中。

off.en: Please turn off the lights before leaving the classroom.

offer.en: The school will offer extra English classes next semester.
offer.zh: 學校下學期會提供額外的英文課。

office.en: Please take the form to the school office before noon.
office.zh: 請在中午前把表格送到校務處。

official.en: The official announcement will be posted on the school website tomorrow.
official.zh: 正式公告明天會發布在學校網站上。

often.en: Students often remember information better after explaining it to others.
often.zh: 學生把資訊解釋給別人聽後，通常會記得更牢。

oil.en: The machine needs a small amount of oil to operate smoothly.
oil.zh: 這台機器需要少量潤滑油才能順暢運作。

old.en: The old bridge was repaired before the rainy season began.
old.zh: 雨季開始前，這座老橋先完成了修繕。

on.en: Please place your books on the table before class begins.
on.zh: 上課前請把書放在桌上。

once.en: We review these vocabulary words once every week.
once.zh: 我們每週複習這些單字一次。

only.en: Only a few students finished the difficult task without help.
only.zh: 只有少數學生在沒有幫助下完成這項困難任務。

open.en: Please open the window to improve the airflow in the room.
open.zh: 請打開窗戶，改善房間內的空氣流通。

operate.en: Only trained students may operate the equipment during the experiment.
operate.zh: 只有受過訓練的學生可以在實驗中操作設備。

operation.en: The operation of the new system requires careful testing first.
operation.zh: 新系統的運作需要先經過仔細測試。

opinion.en: Everyone was invited to share an opinion during the discussion.
opinion.zh: 討論時每個人都被邀請分享自己的意見。

opponent.en: The team studied its opponent carefully before the final match.
opponent.zh: 球隊在決賽前仔細研究了對手。

opportunity.en: The exchange program gives students an opportunity to experience another culture.
opportunity.zh: 交換計畫讓學生有機會體驗另一種文化。

oppose.en: Some residents oppose the plan because they fear increased traffic.
oppose.zh: 一些居民反對這項計畫，因為他們擔心交通增加。

opposite.en: The library is on the opposite side of the street.
opposite.zh: 圖書館在街道的另一側。

opposition.en: The proposal faced strong opposition from several community groups.
opposition.zh: 這項提案遭到幾個社區團體的強烈反對。

option.en: Taking the train is often a convenient option for city travel.
option.zh: 搭火車通常是城市旅行方便的選擇。

or.en: You can submit the assignment online or hand it in personally.
or.zh: 你可以線上繳交作業，也可以親自交。

orange.en: She packed an orange and a sandwich for lunch.
orange.zh: 她帶了一顆柳橙和一個三明治當午餐。

order.en: Please put the events in the correct order before answering.
order.zh: 回答前請把事件按正確順序排列。

ordinary.en: An ordinary object can become useful in a creative experiment.
ordinary.zh: 普通物品在有創意的實驗中也能變得有用。

organization.en: Good organization can make a long report easier to understand.
organization.zh: 良好的組織能讓長篇報告更容易理解。

organize.en: Please organize the information before writing your final report.
organize.zh: 寫最後報告前請先整理資訊。

orient.en: The map helps visitors orient themselves inside the large museum.
orient.zh: 這張地圖幫助訪客在大型博物館內辨認方向。

origin.en: The museum display explains the origin of several local traditions.
origin.zh: 博物館展示說明了幾項地方傳統的起源。

original.en: Each group must present an original idea for the final project.
original.zh: 每組都必須為期末專題提出原創想法。

other.en: Some students prefer reading, while other students learn better by listening.
other.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，其他學生則用聽的學得更好。

otherwise.en: Please save your work now; otherwise, you may lose your changes.
otherwise.zh: 請現在儲存工作，否則可能會遺失變更。

our.en: Our class will present the project results next Friday.
our.zh: 我們班下星期五會報告專題成果。

out.en: We went out during lunch to buy some food.
out.zh: 午餐時間我們出去買了一些食物。

outcome.en: The final outcome depended on how carefully the data were analyzed.
outcome.zh: 最後結果取決於資料分析得多仔細。

outside.en: Several students waited outside the classroom before the test.
outside.zh: 考試前有幾名學生在教室外等候。

over.en: The temperature stayed over thirty degrees throughout the afternoon.
over.zh: 整個下午氣溫都維持在三十度以上。

overall.en: The overall quality of the report improved after several revisions.
overall.zh: 經過幾次修改後，報告的整體品質提升了。

overlap.en: The two circles overlap in the center of the diagram.
overlap.zh: 圖中的兩個圓在中央重疊。

owe.en: I owe my improvement to regular practice and helpful feedback.
owe.zh: 我的進步要歸功於規律練習與有幫助的回饋。

own.en: Students should explain the idea in their own words.
own.zh: 學生應該用自己的話解釋這個觀念。

owner.en: The shop owner decided to stay open one hour later.
owner.zh: 店主決定延後一小時打烊。

page.en: Please turn to page forty before the lesson begins.
page.zh: 上課前請翻到第四十頁。

pain.en: He felt some pain in his shoulder after carrying the boxes.
pain.zh: 搬完箱子後，他的肩膀感到有些疼痛。

paint.en: Students used bright colors to paint the classroom mural.
paint.zh: 學生用鮮豔色彩畫教室壁畫。

painting.en: The painting shows a quiet village beside the sea.
painting.zh: 這幅畫描繪海邊一座寧靜的村莊。

pair.en: Each pair of students compared their answers after the quiz.
pair.zh: 每兩位學生一組，在小考後比較答案。

paper.en: Write your final answer clearly on the paper.
paper.zh: 請把最後答案清楚寫在紙上。

paragraph.en: Each paragraph should focus on one main idea.
paragraph.zh: 每一段都應聚焦在一個主要觀念上。

parallel.en: The two experiments followed parallel procedures with different materials.
parallel.zh: 這兩項實驗使用不同材料，但採用相似的平行流程。

parent.en: A parent attended the meeting to discuss school activities.
parent.zh: 一位家長參加會議討論學校活動。

park.en: We walked through the park after finishing our homework.
park.zh: 寫完作業後，我們穿過公園散步。

part.en: The final part of the report explains the results.
part.zh: 報告的最後一部分說明研究結果。

participate.en: All students are encouraged to participate in the class discussion.
participate.zh: 鼓勵所有學生參與課堂討論。

participation.en: Active participation often makes group discussions more productive.
participation.zh: 積極參與通常能讓小組討論更有效率。

particular.en: This particular example shows why accurate measurement is important.
particular.zh: 這個特定例子說明了精確測量為何重要。

partner.en: My partner checked the data while I prepared the chart.
partner.zh: 我的搭檔檢查資料，而我準備圖表。

party.en: The class held a small party after the final exam.
party.zh: 期末考後，全班舉辦了一個小聚會。

pass.en: You need to pass the final test to complete the course.
pass.zh: 你需要通過期末測驗才能完成這門課。

passage.en: Read the passage carefully before answering the questions.
passage.zh: 回答問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

passenger.en: Each passenger must keep a ticket until leaving the station.
