passenger.zh: 每位乘客都必須保留車票直到離站。

past.en: The town has changed greatly over the past ten years.
past.zh: 這個城鎮在過去十年間有很大變化。

path.en: We followed the path through the forest to the lake.
path.zh: 我們沿著森林小徑走到湖邊。

patient.en: You need to be patient when learning a difficult skill.
patient.zh: 學習困難技能時需要有耐心。

pattern.en: The graph reveals a clear pattern in the monthly data.
pattern.zh: 圖表顯示每月資料中有明顯模式。

pay.en: Students do not need to pay for the online materials.
pay.zh: 學生不需要為線上教材付費。

peace.en: The two groups worked together to promote peace in the community.
peace.zh: 兩個團體合作促進社區和平。

pen.en: I used a blue pen to correct the final draft.
pen.zh: 我用藍筆修改最後一版草稿。

pencil.en: Use a pencil so you can change your answer easily.
pencil.zh: 請使用鉛筆，這樣比較容易修改答案。

people.en: Many people use public transportation to travel across the city.
people.zh: 許多人搭乘大眾運輸在城市中移動。

perceive.en: Different readers may perceive the character's decision in different ways.
perceive.zh: 不同讀者可能會以不同方式看待角色的決定。

percent.en: About sixty percent of the students chose the first option.
percent.zh: 大約百分之六十的學生選擇第一個選項。

percentage.en: The percentage of students using digital textbooks increased this year.
percentage.zh: 今年使用電子課本的學生比例增加了。

perfect.en: The plan is not perfect, but it is practical.
perfect.zh: 這個計畫並不完美，但很實際。

perform.en: Students must perform the experiment exactly as the instructions describe.
perform.zh: 學生必須完全按照說明進行實驗。

performance.en: Her performance improved after she changed her practice routine.
performance.zh: 她改變練習方式後，表現有所提升。

perhaps.en: Perhaps we should collect more evidence before making a decision.
perhaps.zh: 也許我們應該在做決定前蒐集更多證據。

period.en: The temperature changed gradually over a period of three hours.
period.zh: 溫度在三小時期間逐漸改變。

permit.en: The rules permit students to use calculators for this section.
permit.zh: 規定允許學生在這個部分使用計算機。

persist.en: The problem may persist unless the damaged part is replaced.
persist.zh: 除非更換損壞零件，這個問題可能會持續存在。

persistent.en: Persistent practice helped the team improve its presentation skills.
persistent.zh: 持續練習幫助團隊提升簡報能力。

person.en: Each person in the group was given a different task.
person.zh: 小組中的每個人都被分配不同任務。

personal.en: Do not share personal information on an unfamiliar website.
personal.zh: 不要在陌生網站上分享個人資訊。

perspective.en: Reading different sources can help students develop a broader perspective.
perspective.zh: 閱讀不同來源能幫助學生建立更廣的觀點。

persuade.en: The speaker used evidence to persuade the audience to support the plan.
persuade.zh: 講者用證據說服聽眾支持這項計畫。

phenomenon.en: The lesson explains the natural phenomenon using a simple classroom experiment.
phenomenon.zh: 這堂課用簡單的課堂實驗解釋這個自然現象。

phone.en: Please turn off your phone during the exam.

photo.en: We took a group photo in front of the museum.
photo.zh: 我們在博物館前拍了一張團體照。

phrase.en: This phrase is commonly used in formal writing.
phrase.zh: 這個片語常用於正式寫作。

physical.en: Regular exercise supports both physical and mental health.
physical.zh: 規律運動有助於身心健康。

physics.en: Physics helps explain how motion, force, and energy are related.
physics.zh: 物理學幫助解釋運動、力與能量之間的關係。

pick.en: Please pick one topic for your final presentation.
pick.zh: 請為期末報告選一個主題。

picture.en: The picture shows how the machine is assembled.
picture.zh: 這張圖片顯示機器如何組裝。

piece.en: Each piece of evidence should support your main argument.
piece.zh: 每一項證據都應支持你的主要論點。

place.en: The meeting will take place in the school library.
place.zh: 會議將在學校圖書館舉行。

plan.en: We made a clear plan before starting the project.
plan.zh: 開始專題前，我們先擬定了清楚的計畫。

plant.en: This plant grows best in warm and sunny conditions.
plant.zh: 這種植物在溫暖且陽光充足的環境下長得最好。

plastic.en: The school is trying to reduce single-use plastic on campus.
plastic.zh: 學校正努力減少校園內的一次性塑膠。

plate.en: She placed the fruit neatly on a large plate.
plate.zh: 她把水果整齊放在一個大盤子上。

play.en: The students will play basketball after the meeting.
play.zh: 會議後學生要去打籃球。

player.en: Each player must follow the rules during the match.
player.zh: 每位球員在比賽中都必須遵守規則。

please.en: Please check the instructions before beginning the task.
please.zh: 開始任務前請先檢查說明。

point.en: The teacher explained the main point with a simple example.
point.zh: 老師用簡單例子說明主要重點。

police.en: The police closed the road after the accident.
police.zh: 事故發生後，警方封閉了道路。

policy.en: The school introduced a new policy to reduce food waste.
policy.zh: 學校推出新政策以減少食物浪費。

popular.en: This study method is popular because it is simple and effective.
popular.zh: 這種讀書方法因簡單有效而很受歡迎。

population.en: The city's population has grown steadily over the last decade.
population.zh: 這座城市的人口在過去十年間穩定成長。

portion.en: Only a small portion of the data showed unusual results.
portion.zh: 只有一小部分資料顯示異常結果。

pose.en: The sudden change may pose a challenge for small businesses.
pose.zh: 這項突然的改變可能對小型企業造成挑戰。

position.en: Please place the camera in the correct position before recording.
position.zh: 錄影前請把相機放在正確位置。

positive.en: Positive feedback can encourage students to keep improving.
positive.zh: 正向回饋能鼓勵學生持續進步。

possible.en: We considered every possible solution before choosing one.
possible.zh: 我們在做選擇前考慮了所有可能的解決方案。

post.en: The teacher will post the results on the class website.
post.zh: 老師會把結果公布在班級網站上。

potential.en: The new method has great potential for saving both time and energy.
potential.zh: 這種新方法很有潛力同時節省時間與能源。

power.en: Solar panels can provide power for small buildings.
power.zh: 太陽能板可以為小型建築供電。

practice.en: Regular practice is the best way to improve speaking skills.
practice.zh: 規律練習是提升口說能力的最佳方式。

precede.en: A short introduction should precede the detailed analysis in your report.
precede.zh: 報告中的詳細分析前應先有一段簡短介紹。

precise.en: Use precise measurements when recording the length of each sample.
precise.zh: 記錄每個樣本的長度時，請使用精確測量。

predict.en: The model can predict changes in temperature with reasonable accuracy.
predict.zh: 這個模型能以合理準確度預測溫度變化。

prediction.en: Her prediction was based on patterns found in earlier data.
prediction.zh: 她的預測是根據先前資料中的模式做出的。

preliminary.en: The preliminary results suggest that the new method may be effective.
preliminary.zh: 初步結果顯示新方法可能有效。

prepare.en: Students should prepare their notes before the discussion begins.
prepare.zh: 討論開始前，學生應先準備好筆記。

present.en: Each group will present its findings to the class tomorrow.
present.zh: 每個小組明天都要向全班報告研究結果。

presentation.en: Her presentation included clear charts and useful examples.
presentation.zh: 她的報告包含清楚的圖表與實用例子。

preserve.en: The project aims to preserve historic buildings in the neighborhood.
preserve.zh: 這項計畫旨在保存社區中的歷史建築。

pressure.en: Too much pressure can make it harder to concentrate.
pressure.zh: 過大的壓力會讓人更難專心。

presume.en: Do not presume the answer before examining all the evidence.
presume.zh: 在檢視所有證據前，不要先假定答案。

prevail.en: Calm discussion should prevail when group members disagree about a plan.
prevail.zh: 當組員對計畫有不同意見時，應以冷靜討論為主。

prevent.en: Good planning can prevent many common mistakes.
prevent.zh: 良好規劃可以避免許多常見錯誤。

price.en: The price of the ticket includes admission to the museum.
price.zh: 票價包含博物館入場費。

primary.en: Our primary goal is to improve reading comprehension.
primary.zh: 我們的主要目標是提升閱讀理解能力。

principal.en: The principal reason for the delay was heavy rain.
principal.zh: 延誤的主要原因是大雨。

principle.en: The teacher explained the principle with a simple real-world example.
principle.zh: 老師用簡單的真實例子解釋這項原理。

print.en: Please print the report before the meeting begins.
print.zh: 會議開始前請把報告印出來。

prior.en: Prior experience with the software can make the task easier.
prior.zh: 先前使用這套軟體的經驗可以讓任務更容易。

priority.en: Student safety should always remain the highest priority during experiments.
priority.zh: 學生安全在實驗中應永遠是最高優先事項。

private.en: The website keeps each user's private information protected.
private.zh: 這個網站會保護每位使用者的私人資訊。

probably.en: The bus will probably arrive within the next ten minutes.
probably.zh: 公車大概會在接下來十分鐘內抵達。

problem.en: We solved the problem by checking each step carefully.
problem.zh: 我們透過仔細檢查每個步驟解決了問題。

procedure.en: Follow the procedure carefully so the results can be compared fairly.
procedure.zh: 請仔細遵循程序，讓結果可以公平比較。

proceed.en: The class will proceed to the next activity after a short break.
proceed.zh: 短暫休息後，全班會繼續進行下一個活動。

process.en: Learning a language is a gradual process that takes time.
process.zh: 學習語言是一個需要時間的漸進過程。

produce.en: The new method can produce more accurate results.
produce.zh: 這個新方法可以產生更準確的結果。

product.en: The company tested the product before releasing it to customers.
product.zh: 公司在產品上市前先進行測試。

professional.en: The speaker gave professional advice about preparing for future careers.
professional.zh: 講者提供了有關未來職涯準備的專業建議。

profound.en: The invention had a profound effect on how people shared information.
profound.zh: 這項發明對人們分享資訊的方式產生深遠影響。

program.en: The school program helps students improve their reading skills.
program.zh: 這項學校計畫幫助學生提升閱讀能力。

prohibit.en: School rules prohibit students from entering the laboratory without permission.
prohibit.zh: 校規禁止學生未經允許進入實驗室。

project.en: Our project examines how sleep affects student learning.
project.zh: 我們的專題探討睡眠如何影響學生學習。

prominent.en: The chart highlights a prominent increase in energy use during winter.
prominent.zh: 這張圖表顯示冬季能源使用量有明顯增加。

promise.en: He made a promise to finish his part of the work.
promise.zh: 他答應會完成自己負責的工作。

prompt.en: The warning message should prompt users to save their work immediately.
prompt.zh: 警告訊息應提醒使用者立刻儲存工作。

proper.en: Use proper equipment when conducting the science experiment.
proper.zh: 進行科學實驗時要使用適當設備。

proportion.en: A large proportion of students preferred the shorter reading passage.
proportion.zh: 很大比例的學生比較喜歡較短的閱讀文章。

prospect.en: The prospect of studying abroad encouraged her to improve her English.
prospect.zh: 出國留學的前景鼓勵她提升英文能力。

protect.en: Trees can help protect the soil from heavy rain.
protect.zh: 樹木可以幫助保護土壤免受大雨侵蝕。

prove.en: One experiment cannot prove that a theory is always correct.
prove.zh: 單一實驗不能證明某個理論永遠正確。

psychology.en: Psychology examines how people think, feel, and behave in different situations.
psychology.zh: 心理學研究人們在不同情境下如何思考、感受與行動。

public.en: The new library is open to the public on weekends.
public.zh: 新圖書館週末對大眾開放。

publication.en: The article was accepted for publication in the school science magazine.
publication.zh: 這篇文章獲接受刊登在校內科學雜誌。

publish.en: The school plans to publish the winning essays next month.
publish.zh: 學校計畫下個月刊登得獎文章。

purchase.en: The library will purchase more reference books for senior students.
purchase.zh: 圖書館將為高年級學生購買更多參考書。

purpose.en: The purpose of this activity is to practice critical thinking.
purpose.zh: 這項活動的目的是練習批判思考。

pursue.en: She hopes to pursue further study in environmental science someday.
pursue.zh: 她希望未來繼續深造環境科學。

qualify.en: Students must qualify through the first round before entering the final.
qualify.zh: 學生必須先通過第一輪資格才能進入決賽。

quality.en: The team checked the quality of the data before analysis.
quality.zh: 團隊在分析前先檢查資料品質。

quantity.en: The experiment compares how quantity affects the final result.
quantity.zh: 這項實驗比較數量如何影響最後結果。

question.en: Please answer each question using evidence from the passage.
question.zh: 請使用文章中的證據回答每一題。

quick.en: A quick review before class can improve understanding.
quick.zh: 上課前快速複習能提升理解。

quiet.en: The library provides a quiet place for students to study.
quiet.zh: 圖書館提供學生一個安靜的讀書場所。

quite.en: The final question was quite difficult for most students.
quite.zh: 最後一題對大多數學生來說相當困難。

race.en: Several teams entered the race despite the hot weather.
race.zh: 儘管天氣炎熱，仍有好幾支隊伍參加比賽。

radical.en: The proposal suggests a radical change to the current transportation system.
radical.zh: 這項提案建議對目前交通系統進行徹底改變。

radio.en: The radio reported heavy traffic on the highway this morning.
radio.zh: 收音機今早報導高速公路交通壅塞。

rain.en: The rain became heavier just before we reached the station.
rain.zh: 就在我們抵達車站前，雨勢變得更大。

raise.en: The school hopes to raise enough money for new library books.
raise.zh: 學校希望募到足夠的錢購買新的圖書館書籍。

random.en: The researchers selected a random sample from the student population.
random.zh: 研究人員從學生族群中選取隨機樣本。

range.en: The survey included students from a wide range of backgrounds.
range.zh: 這項調查包含來自各種不同背景的學生。

rapid.en: The city experienced rapid growth during the past decade.
rapid.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間快速成長。

rare.en: It is rare to see snow in this part of Taiwan.
rare.zh: 在台灣這個地區看到下雪很少見。

rate.en: The report shows that the recycling rate increased last year.
rate.zh: 報告顯示去年的回收率提高了。

rather.en: I would rather walk than wait twenty minutes for the bus.
rather.zh: 我寧願走路，也不想等二十分鐘的公車。

rational.en: A rational decision should be based on evidence and clear reasoning.
rational.zh: 合理的決定應建立在證據與清楚推理之上。

reach.en: We expect to reach the mountain shelter before sunset.
reach.zh: 我們預計在日落前抵達山屋。

react.en: Some materials react differently when they are exposed to heat.
react.zh: 有些材料接觸熱能時會有不同反應。

reaction.en: The chemical reaction released enough heat to change the temperature.
reaction.zh: 這個化學反應釋放了足以改變溫度的熱量。

read.en: Please read the passage carefully before answering the questions.
read.zh: 回答問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

ready.en: The students were ready to begin when the teacher arrived.
ready.zh: 老師到達時，學生已經準備好開始了。

real.en: The project asks students to solve a real problem in their community.
real.zh: 這項專題要求學生解決社區中的真實問題。

realize.en: She began to realize how important regular review was.
realize.zh: 她開始了解到規律複習有多重要。

really.en: This example really helps explain the idea more clearly.
really.zh: 這個例子真的讓這個觀念更容易理解。

reason.en: Please give one reason for choosing that answer.
reason.zh: 請說明你選擇那個答案的一個理由。

reasonable.en: The teacher gave us a reasonable amount of time to finish.
reasonable.zh: 老師給了我們合理的時間完成任務。

receive.en: Students will receive their test results next Monday.
receive.zh: 學生會在下星期一收到考試結果。

recent.en: A recent study examined how sleep affects student performance.
recent.zh: 最近一項研究探討睡眠如何影響學生表現。

recognize.en: Students should learn to recognize common patterns in academic writing.
recognize.zh: 學生應學會辨識學術寫作中常見的模式。

recommend.en: Teachers often recommend regular reading to improve vocabulary.
recommend.zh: 老師常建議透過規律閱讀來增進字彙量。

reconcile.en: The team tried to reconcile the two different sets of results.
reconcile.zh: 團隊試著調和兩組不同的結果。

record.en: Please record your observations immediately after the experiment.
record.zh: 實驗後請立即記錄你的觀察結果。

recover.en: The local economy began to recover after several difficult months.
recover.zh: 經過幾個艱難月份後，當地經濟開始復甦。

reduce.en: Turning off unused lights can reduce energy consumption.
reduce.zh: 關掉不用的燈可以減少能源消耗。

refer.en: Please refer to the chart when explaining the change in results.
refer.zh: 解釋結果變化時請參考圖表。

reference.en: The report includes a reference to several earlier studies.
reference.zh: 這份報告引用了幾項早期研究。

refine.en: The team will refine the model after reviewing the test results.
refine.zh: 團隊檢視測試結果後會改良模型。

reflect.en: The final score may reflect both effort and understanding.
reflect.zh: 最後成績可能同時反映努力與理解程度。

regard.en: Many students regard the library as their favorite study place.
regard.zh: 許多學生把圖書館視為最喜歡的讀書地點。

region.en: This region receives heavy rain during the summer months.
region.zh: 這個地區夏季會有大量降雨。

regular.en: Regular practice is important for building strong language skills.
regular.zh: 規律練習對建立扎實語言能力很重要。

regulate.en: The device can regulate temperature automatically during the experiment.
regulate.zh: 這個裝置能在實驗過程中自動調節溫度。

reinforce.en: Regular review can reinforce what students learned in class.
reinforce.zh: 規律複習可以強化學生在課堂上學到的內容。

relation.en: The study explores the relation between exercise and concentration.
relation.zh: 這項研究探討運動與專注力之間的關係。

relationship.en: A good relationship requires trust and clear communication.
relationship.zh: 良好的關係需要信任與清楚溝通。

relative.en: The relative importance of each factor depends on the situation.
relative.zh: 每個因素的相對重要性取決於情況。

relax.en: Listening to quiet music can help students relax after studying.
relax.zh: 讀書後聽安靜的音樂可以幫助學生放鬆。

release.en: The organization will release the final report next week.
release.zh: 這個組織會在下週發布最終報告。

relevant.en: Include only relevant information when answering the reading question.
relevant.zh: 回答閱讀題時，只要包含相關資訊。

reliable.en: A reliable source explains its evidence and identifies where the information came from.
reliable.zh: 可靠的來源會說明證據，並指出資訊從何而來。

relief.en: Finishing the final exam brought a sense of relief.
relief.zh: 完成期末考讓人有種鬆一口氣的感覺。

reluctant.en: He was reluctant to change the design without testing it first.
reluctant.zh: 他不太願意在尚未測試前就更改設計。

rely.en: Good decisions should rely on evidence rather than guesswork.
rely.zh: 好的決定應該依靠證據，而不是猜測。

remain.en: Please remain seated until the teacher finishes the instructions.
remain.zh: 請保持坐著，直到老師說明完畢。

remember.en: I use a short review to remember difficult vocabulary better.
remember.zh: 我用簡短複習來更牢記困難單字。

remind.en: Please remind me to bring the science worksheet tomorrow.
remind.zh: 請提醒我明天帶自然科學習單。

remove.en: Please remove unnecessary details before submitting the final report.
remove.zh: 提交最後報告前請刪除不必要的細節。

render.en: Poor lighting can render small text difficult to read.
render.zh: 光線不足可能讓小字變得難以閱讀。

repeat.en: The teacher asked us to repeat the sentence more clearly.
repeat.zh: 老師請我們把句子再清楚重複一次。

replace.en: The school plans to replace several old computers this year.
replace.zh: 學校計畫今年汰換幾台老舊電腦。

reply.en: Please reply to the email before Friday afternoon.
reply.zh: 請在星期五下午前回覆這封電子郵件。

report.en: Each group must submit a short report after the experiment.
report.zh: 每個小組都必須在實驗後繳交一份簡短報告。

request.en: The office received a request for additional study materials.
request.zh: 辦公室收到一項要求提供額外學習材料的申請。

require.en: This experiment will require careful measurement and accurate records.
require.zh: 這項實驗需要仔細測量與準確記錄。

requirement.en: Regular attendance is a basic requirement for completing the course.
requirement.zh: 規律出席是完成這門課的基本要求。

research.en: The students conducted research on how noise affects learning.
research.zh: 學生進行了噪音如何影響學習的研究。

researcher.en: The researcher interviewed students from several different schools.
researcher.zh: 研究人員訪問了來自數所不同學校的學生。

reserve.en: We need to reserve the meeting room before Friday.
reserve.zh: 我們需要在星期五前預訂會議室。

resist.en: Some materials can resist high temperatures better than others.
resist.zh: 有些材料比其他材料更能耐高溫。

resolve.en: The group met after class to resolve the remaining disagreement.
resolve.zh: 小組下課後開會解決剩下的分歧。

resource.en: The website provides a useful resource for students reviewing vocabulary.
resource.zh: 這個網站為複習單字的學生提供有用資源。

respect.en: Students should respect different opinions during class discussions.
respect.zh: 學生在課堂討論時應尊重不同意見。

respective.en: The two teams returned to their respective classrooms after the meeting.
respective.zh: 兩個小組在會議後回到各自的教室。

respond.en: Students should respond clearly to each question on the worksheet.
respond.zh: 學生應清楚回答學習單上的每個問題。

response.en: Her response showed that she understood the main idea.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她理解了主要概念。

responsibility.en: Keeping the classroom clean is everyone's responsibility.
responsibility.zh: 維持教室整潔是每個人的責任。

responsible.en: Students are responsible for bringing their own materials to class.
responsible.zh: 學生有責任自行攜帶上課材料。

rest.en: A short rest can help you concentrate better afterward.
rest.zh: 短暫休息可以幫助你之後更專心。

restaurant.en: The restaurant uses local vegetables in many of its dishes.
restaurant.zh: 這家餐廳在許多料理中使用當地蔬菜。

restore.en: Technicians worked to restore the network after the unexpected outage.
restore.zh: 技術人員在突發斷線後努力恢復網路。

restrain.en: The barrier helps restrain water during periods of heavy rainfall.
restrain.zh: 這道屏障有助於在豪雨期間控制水流。

restrict.en: The school may restrict access to the laboratory after hours.
restrict.zh: 學校可能限制放學後進入實驗室。

result.en: The result was different from what we had expected.
result.zh: 結果和我們原本預期的不一樣。

retain.en: Students retain information better when they review it regularly.
retain.zh: 學生規律複習時能更好地保留資訊。

return.en: Please return the borrowed book by next Monday.
return.zh: 請在下星期一前歸還借閱的書。

reveal.en: The survey results reveal a change in students' study habits.
reveal.zh: 調查結果顯示學生的讀書習慣出現變化。

review.en: A quick review before class can improve your understanding.
review.zh: 上課前快速複習可以提升理解。

revise.en: Please revise the paragraph after reading the teacher's comments.
revise.zh: 閱讀老師的評語後，請修改這一段。

revision.en: The final revision made the argument clearer and more convincing.
revision.zh: 最後一次修改讓論點更清楚、更有說服力。

reward.en: The teacher gave a small reward to the winning team.
reward.zh: 老師給優勝隊伍一個小獎勵。

rice.en: Rice is an important food in many parts of Asia.
rice.zh: 米飯是亞洲許多地區的重要食物。

rich.en: The soil is rich enough to support many kinds of plants.
rich.zh: 這片土壤很肥沃，足以讓多種植物生長。

ride.en: We decided to ride our bicycles along the river.
ride.zh: 我們決定騎腳踏車沿著河邊前進。

right.en: Make sure you choose the right file before uploading it.
right.zh: 上傳前要確認你選的是正確檔案。

rigid.en: A rigid schedule may be difficult to follow during a busy week.
rigid.zh: 在忙碌的一週裡，過於僵化的行程可能很難遵守。

ring.en: The school bell will ring at eight o'clock.
ring.zh: 學校鐘聲會在八點響起。

rise.en: Temperatures often rise quickly after the sun comes out.
rise.zh: 太陽出來後，氣溫通常會快速上升。

risk.en: Sharing passwords online creates a serious security risk.
risk.zh: 在網路上分享密碼會造成嚴重的安全風險。

river.en: The river becomes wider as it approaches the sea.
river.zh: 這條河接近海洋時會變得更寬。

road.en: The road was closed because of a landslide after heavy rain.
road.zh: 大雨後發生土石滑落，因此道路封閉。

robust.en: The researchers need robust evidence before changing their conclusion.
robust.zh: 研究人員需要有力的證據，才會改變結論。

role.en: Technology plays an important role in modern education.
role.zh: 科技在現代教育中扮演重要角色。

room.en: The room was quiet enough for everyone to study.
room.zh: 房間很安靜，大家都能讀書。

rough.en: The rough surface created more friction during the experiment.
rough.zh: 粗糙的表面在實驗中產生更多摩擦力。

round.en: We sat around a round table for the discussion.
round.zh: 我們圍著一張圓桌進行討論。

route.en: This bus route connects the station with the university.
route.zh: 這條公車路線連接車站與大學。

routine.en: A regular study routine can make exam preparation less stressful.
routine.zh: 規律的讀書習慣能讓考試準備更不焦慮。

rule.en: Every student must follow the same safety rule in the laboratory.
rule.zh: 每位學生在實驗室都必須遵守相同的安全規定。

run.en: The program will run automatically after you press the button.
run.zh: 按下按鈕後，程式會自動執行。

safe.en: Keep the chemicals in a safe place away from children.
safe.zh: 請把化學物品放在遠離孩童的安全位置。

safety.en: Safety should always come first during laboratory activities.
safety.zh: 進行實驗室活動時，安全永遠應放在第一位。

same.en: The two experiments used the same amount of water.
same.zh: 這兩個實驗使用了相同的水量。

sample.en: The students examined a small sample under the microscope.
sample.zh: 學生在顯微鏡下觀察一小份樣本。

save.en: Remember to save your document before closing the program.
save.zh: 關閉程式前記得儲存文件。

say.en: Please say your answer clearly so everyone can hear it.
say.zh: 請清楚說出答案，讓大家都聽得到。

scale.en: The map uses a simple scale to show distance.
scale.zh: 這張地圖使用簡單比例尺來表示距離。

scarce.en: Clean water becomes scarce in some regions during long droughts.
scarce.zh: 長期乾旱期間，有些地區的乾淨用水會變得稀缺。

school.en: Our school will hold a science fair next month.
school.zh: 我們學校下個月會舉辦科展。

science.en: Science helps us explain many patterns in the natural world.
science.zh: 科學幫助我們解釋自然界中的許多現象。

scientific.en: A scientific explanation should be supported by clear evidence.
scientific.zh: 科學解釋應該由明確證據支持。

scientist.en: The scientist repeated the experiment to confirm the result.
scientist.zh: 科學家重複實驗以確認結果。

scope.en: The project expanded its scope to include students from three schools.
scope.zh: 這項專題擴大範圍，納入三所學校的學生。

score.en: Her score improved after several weeks of regular practice.
score.zh: 經過幾週規律練習後，她的分數提高了。

screen.en: The answer will appear on the screen after you submit.
screen.zh: 提交後答案會出現在螢幕上。

search.en: Students can search the library database for useful sources.
search.zh: 學生可以搜尋圖書館資料庫來找有用來源。

season.en: Spring is my favorite season because the weather is mild.
season.zh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節，因為天氣溫和。

seat.en: Please take your seat before the presentation begins.

second.en: The second experiment produced a more accurate result.
second.zh: 第二次實驗得到更準確的結果。

section.en: Read the final section before answering the last question.
section.zh: 回答最後一題前請閱讀最後一節。

see.en: We can see a clear pattern in the final graph.
see.zh: 我們可以在最後的圖表中看出明顯模式。

seem.en: The task may seem difficult at first, but practice helps.
seem.zh: 這項任務一開始可能看起來很難，但練習會有幫助。

select.en: Please select one topic for your final presentation.
select.zh: 請為期末報告選擇一個主題。

sell.en: The school club will sell snacks to raise money.
sell.zh: 學校社團會賣點心來募款。

send.en: Please send the completed file to your teacher by Friday.
send.zh: 請在星期五前把完成的檔案寄給老師。

sense.en: The explanation makes more sense after seeing the diagram.
sense.zh: 看過圖示後，這個解釋就更容易理解。

sentence.en: Write one sentence using each of the new vocabulary words.
sentence.zh: 請用每個新單字各寫一句話。

separate.en: Please separate the paper from the plastic before recycling.
separate.zh: 回收前請把紙類和塑膠分開。

sequence.en: Put the events in the correct sequence before answering the question.
sequence.zh: 回答問題前，先把事件按正確順序排列。

series.en: The teacher showed a series of images to explain the process.
series.zh: 老師展示一系列圖片來說明這個過程。

serious.en: Air pollution is a serious problem in many large cities.
serious.zh: 空氣污染是許多大城市的嚴重問題。

serve.en: This chart can serve as a useful summary of the results.
serve.zh: 這張圖表可以作為結果的實用摘要。

service.en: The library provides an online service for renewing borrowed books.
service.zh: 圖書館提供線上續借服務。

set.en: The teacher set a clear deadline for the final project.
set.zh: 老師為期末專題設定了明確期限。

several.en: Several students volunteered to help with the school event.
several.zh: 有幾位學生自願協助學校活動。

share.en: Students should share useful ideas during group discussions.
share.zh: 學生應在小組討論中分享有用想法。

short.en: The teacher gave us a short quiz at the end of class.
short.zh: 老師在下課前給我們一份簡短小考。

side.en: Please write your name on the left side of the page.
side.zh: 請把名字寫在頁面的左側。

sign.en: The sign clearly explains where visitors should wait.
sign.zh: 這個標誌清楚說明訪客應在哪裡等候。

signal.en: The red signal means that the machine should stop.
signal.zh: 紅色訊號表示機器應停止運作。

significant.en: The study found a significant difference between the two groups.
significant.zh: 這項研究發現兩組之間有顯著差異。

similar.en: The two solutions are similar, but one is much cheaper.
similar.zh: 這兩個解決方案很相似，但其中一個便宜很多。

simple.en: A simple example can make a difficult concept easier to understand.
simple.zh: 簡單例子能讓困難概念更容易理解。

simply.en: The teacher simply asked us to explain our reasoning clearly.
simply.zh: 老師只是要求我們清楚說明推理過程。

since.en: The school has changed a lot since I first arrived.
since.zh: 自從我剛來時起，學校已經改變很多。

single.en: A single mistake can affect the final calculation.
single.zh: 一個小錯誤就可能影響最後計算。

site.en: The new school building site is near the sports field.
site.zh: 新校舍的工地位於運動場附近。

situation.en: The teacher explained how to respond calmly in an emergency situation.
situation.zh: 老師說明在緊急情況下如何冷靜應對。

skeptical.en: Students should remain skeptical of claims that lack clear evidence.
skeptical.zh: 學生應對缺乏明確證據的主張保持懷疑。

sleep.en: Enough sleep is important for memory and concentration.
sleep.zh: 充足睡眠對記憶力和專注力很重要。

small.en: A small change in temperature affected the final result.
small.zh: 溫度的一點小變化影響了最後結果。

social.en: Social media can spread information very quickly.
social.zh: 社群媒體可以非常快速地傳播資訊。

society.en: Technology has changed many aspects of modern society.
society.zh: 科技改變了現代社會的許多面向。

sole.en: Cost should not be the sole reason for choosing a solution.
sole.zh: 成本不應該是選擇解決方案的唯一理由。

solution.en: The team proposed a practical solution to the traffic problem.
solution.zh: 團隊提出了一個實際的交通問題解決方案。

solve.en: Students worked together to solve the difficult problem.
solve.zh: 學生合作解決這個困難問題。

some.en: Some students prefer studying alone, while others like groups.
some.zh: 有些學生喜歡自己讀書，其他人則喜歡小組學習。

someone.en: Someone left a notebook on the desk after class.
someone.zh: 下課後有人把筆記本留在桌上。

something.en: There is something unusual about the final result.
something.zh: 最後結果有一些不尋常的地方。

sometimes.en: Students sometimes need extra time to understand difficult ideas.
sometimes.zh: 學生有時需要更多時間理解困難觀念。

sophisticated.en: The sophisticated model can analyze several variables at the same time.
sophisticated.zh: 這個精密模型可以同時分析數個變數。

source.en: Always check the source before using information in a report.
source.zh: 在報告中使用資訊前，一定要先檢查來源。

space.en: The new library has more space for quiet study.
space.zh: 新圖書館有更多安靜讀書的空間。

speak.en: Please speak slowly so everyone can understand you.
speak.zh: 請說慢一點，讓每個人都能理解。

special.en: The school organized a special event for graduating students.
special.zh: 學校為畢業生舉辦了一場特別活動。

specific.en: Please give a specific example to support your main point.
specific.zh: 請舉一個具體例子來支持你的主要觀點。

specify.en: Please specify which source you used for each important claim.
specify.zh: 請註明每項重要主張使用了哪個來源。

speech.en: She practiced her speech several times before the competition.
speech.zh: 比賽前她把演講練習了好幾次。

spend.en: I spend about an hour reviewing English every evening.
spend.zh: 我每天晚上大約花一小時複習英文。

spontaneous.en: A spontaneous discussion began after the class watched the short film.
spontaneous.zh: 全班看完短片後，自發展開了一場討論。

stable.en: The temperature remained stable throughout the entire experiment.
stable.zh: 整個實驗期間，溫度都維持穩定。

standard.en: The school follows a standard procedure for laboratory safety checks.
standard.zh: 學校遵循標準程序進行實驗室安全檢查。

start.en: Please start the experiment only after reading the instructions.
start.zh: 請在看完說明後才開始實驗。

state.en: The report describes the current state of the local environment.
state.zh: 這份報告描述當地環境目前的狀況。

statement.en: The statement is supported by evidence from several studies.
statement.zh: 這項陳述有多項研究證據支持。

statistic.en: One statistic alone cannot explain the whole social issue.
statistic.zh: 單一統計數字無法解釋整個社會議題。

stay.en: We decided to stay indoors because of the heavy rain.
stay.zh: 因為大雨，我們決定待在室內。

step.en: Follow each step carefully to avoid making mistakes.
step.zh: 請仔細按照每個步驟，以避免犯錯。

still.en: The room was still quiet even after the class ended.
still.zh: 即使下課後，房間仍然很安靜。

story.en: The story shows how one decision can change a person's life.
story.zh: 這個故事顯示一個決定如何改變一個人的人生。

strategy.en: A clear study strategy can help you use your time better.
strategy.zh: 清楚的讀書策略可以幫助你更有效運用時間。

strong.en: A strong argument needs clear reasons and reliable evidence.
strong.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚理由和可靠證據。

structure.en: The essay has a clear structure with an introduction and conclusion.
structure.zh: 這篇文章有清楚的結構，包含前言與結論。

student.en: Each student must complete the survey before Friday.
student.zh: 每位學生都必須在星期五前完成問卷。

study.en: Regular study habits can improve performance over time.
study.zh: 規律的讀書習慣能逐漸提升表現。

subject.en: Math is the subject I find most challenging this year.
subject.zh: 數學是我今年覺得最有挑戰的科目。

submit.en: Please submit your assignment before noon on Friday.
submit.zh: 請在星期五中午以前繳交作業。

subordinate.en: The report treats design details as subordinate to safety requirements.
subordinate.zh: 這份報告把設計細節放在安全要求之後。

subsequent.en: Subsequent tests confirmed the pattern found in the first experiment.
subsequent.zh: 後續測試確認了第一次實驗中發現的模式。

substantial.en: The project required a substantial amount of planning and teamwork.
substantial.zh: 這項專題需要大量的規劃與團隊合作。

substitute.en: You can substitute water for milk in this simple experiment.
substitute.zh: 在這個簡單實驗中，你可以用水代替牛奶。

subtle.en: The two pictures contain a subtle difference in the background.
subtle.zh: 這兩張圖片的背景中有一個細微差異。

success.en: Careful preparation played an important role in the team's success.
success.zh: 仔細準備在團隊成功中扮演重要角色。

successful.en: The project was successful because everyone completed their tasks.
successful.zh: 這項專題很成功，因為每個人都完成了自己的工作。

successive.en: Each successive test produced a slightly more accurate result.
successive.zh: 每次接續進行的測試都產生稍微更準確的結果。

such.en: Such examples can help students understand abstract ideas more easily.
such.zh: 這類例子能幫助學生更容易理解抽象觀念。

sudden.en: A sudden change in weather forced us to leave early.
sudden.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使我們提早離開。

sufficient.en: The available evidence was sufficient to support the final conclusion.
sufficient.zh: 現有證據足以支持最後的結論。

suggest.en: The results suggest that regular review improves long-term memory.
suggest.zh: 結果顯示規律複習能改善長期記憶。

summarize.en: Please summarize the main argument in two or three sentences.
summarize.zh: 請用兩到三句話總結主要論點。

supplement.en: The teacher provided extra readings to supplement the textbook.
supplement.zh: 老師提供額外閱讀資料來補充課本內容。

support.en: Use evidence from the passage to support your answer.
support.zh: 請用文章中的證據支持你的答案。

suppress.en: Thick curtains can suppress some outside noise during the recording.
suppress.zh: 厚窗簾可以在錄音時減少部分外部噪音。

sure.en: Make sure the file is saved before closing the program.
sure.zh: 關閉程式前要確認檔案已經儲存。

survey.en: The class conducted a survey about students' reading habits.
survey.zh: 全班進行了一項關於學生閱讀習慣的調查。

sustain.en: Regular maintenance can help sustain the system's performance over time.
sustain.zh: 定期維護有助於長期維持系統效能。

symbol.en: A red circle can serve as a symbol of warning.
symbol.zh: 紅色圓圈可以作為警告的象徵。

system.en: The new system makes it easier to track student progress.
system.zh: 新系統讓追蹤學生進度變得更容易。

table.en: The results are organized in a table for easy comparison.
table.zh: 結果整理在表格中，方便比較。

take.en: Please take notes while you listen to the presentation.

talk.en: We need to talk about how to divide the work fairly.
talk.zh: 我們需要討論如何公平分配工作。

target.en: Our target is to finish all three tasks before lunch.
target.zh: 我們的目標是在午餐前完成三項任務。

task.en: Each student received a different task for the group project.
task.zh: 每位學生在小組專題中都分到不同任務。

teach.en: Good examples can teach difficult ideas more effectively than definitions alone.
teach.zh: 好的例子往往比單靠定義更能教會困難觀念。

teacher.en: The teacher explained the instructions before the activity began.
teacher.zh: 活動開始前，老師先說明了指示。

team.en: The team worked together to solve the problem before class ended.
team.zh: 團隊合作在下課前解決了問題。

technique.en: This technique helps students organize complex information more clearly.
technique.zh: 這種技巧能幫助學生更清楚整理複雜資訊。

technology.en: Technology has changed how students access information and communicate.
technology.zh: 科技改變了學生取得資訊與溝通的方式。

telephone.en: The office telephone rang several times during the meeting.
telephone.zh: 會議期間辦公室電話響了好幾次。

television.en: The documentary was shown on national television last night.
television.zh: 這部紀錄片昨晚在全國電視台播出。

tell.en: Please tell the group what you observed during the experiment.
tell.zh: 請告訴小組你在實驗中觀察到的現象。

temperature.en: The temperature dropped quickly after the sun went down.
temperature.zh: 太陽下山後，氣溫快速下降。

temporary.en: The library is using a temporary entrance during the renovation.
temporary.zh: 圖書館整修期間使用臨時入口。

tentative.en: The team made a tentative schedule before confirming all dates.
tentative.zh: 團隊在確認所有日期前先擬定暫定時程。

term.en: The teacher defined the new term before using it in discussion.
term.zh: 老師在討論中使用新術語前先加以定義。

test.en: The test includes reading, vocabulary, and short writing questions.
test.zh: 這份測驗包含閱讀、單字和短文寫作題。

text.en: Read the text carefully before answering the questions below.
text.zh: 回答下方問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

than.en: This method is faster than the one we used yesterday.
than.zh: 這個方法比我們昨天使用的方法更快。

thank.en: We should thank the volunteers for helping with the event.
thank.zh: 我們應該感謝志工協助這場活動。

that.en: The evidence shows that the new method is more effective.
that.zh: 證據顯示新方法更有效。

the.en: The students entered the classroom quietly before the test.
the.zh: 學生在考試前安靜地進入教室。

their.en: The students presented their findings to the whole class.
their.zh: 學生向全班報告他們的研究結果。

them.en: The teacher gave them extra time to finish the assignment.
them.zh: 老師給他們更多時間完成作業。

then.en: Read the instructions first, then begin the experiment.
then.zh: 先閱讀說明，接著再開始實驗。

theoretical.en: The lesson connects theoretical ideas with simple real-world examples.
theoretical.zh: 這堂課把理論概念和簡單的生活實例連結起來。

theory.en: The experiment was designed to test a simple scientific theory.
theory.zh: 這個實驗是為了檢驗一項簡單的科學理論。

there.en: There are several possible answers to this question.
there.zh: 這個問題有好幾種可能的答案。

therefore.en: The road was closed; therefore, we had to choose another route.
therefore.zh: 道路封閉了，因此我們必須選擇另一條路。

these.en: These examples show how the rule works in different situations.
these.zh: 這些例子顯示這項規則在不同情況下如何運作。

they.en: They reviewed the report together before submitting it.
they.zh: 他們在提交報告前一起檢查內容。

thick.en: The book has a thick cover that protects the pages well.
thick.zh: 這本書有厚實的封面，能很好地保護書頁。

thin.en: A thin layer of ice formed on the water overnight.
thin.zh: 夜裡水面形成了一層薄冰。

thing.en: The most important thing is to understand why the answer is correct.
thing.zh: 最重要的是理解答案為什麼正確。

think.en: Take a moment to think before choosing your final answer.
think.zh: 選擇最後答案前先花一點時間思考。

third.en: The team finished third in the regional competition.
third.zh: 這支隊伍在地區比賽中獲得第三名。

this.en: This chart compares the results from three different classes.
this.zh: 這張圖表比較三個不同班級的結果。

those.en: Those students volunteered to help clean the school grounds.
those.zh: 那些學生自願幫忙清理校園。

though.en: Though the task was difficult, everyone completed it on time.
though.zh: 雖然任務很難，每個人仍準時完成。

thought.en: She gave careful thought to each option before deciding.
thought.zh: 她在做決定前仔細考慮了每個選項。

thousand.en: More than a thousand people attended the festival this year.
thousand.zh: 今年有超過一千人參加這場節慶活動。

through.en: We walked through the park on our way to the station.
through.zh: 我們前往車站途中穿過了公園。

throughout.en: The weather remained cool throughout the entire weekend.
throughout.zh: 整個週末天氣都維持涼爽。

throw.en: Please do not throw paper into the wrong recycling bin.
throw.zh: 請不要把紙丟進錯誤的回收桶。

ticket.en: Keep your ticket until you leave the station.
ticket.zh: 離開車站前請保留車票。

time.en: Good time management can reduce stress before major exams.
time.zh: 良好的時間管理能減少大考前的壓力。

tiny.en: A tiny crack appeared near the edge of the glass.
tiny.zh: 玻璃邊緣出現了一道很小的裂痕。

title.en: Choose a clear title that matches the main idea of your report.
title.zh: 請選一個符合報告主旨的清楚標題。

to.en: Students went to the library to prepare for the exam.
to.zh: 學生去圖書館準備考試。

today.en: We will review the most important vocabulary today.
today.zh: 我們今天會複習最重要的單字。

together.en: The two groups worked together to complete the final presentation.
together.zh: 兩個小組合作完成了最後報告。

tolerate.en: This plant can tolerate dry conditions better than the other species.
tolerate.zh: 這種植物比其他種類更能耐受乾燥環境。

tomorrow.en: Please bring your completed worksheet to class tomorrow.
tomorrow.zh: 明天上課請帶完成的學習單。

tonight.en: I plan to review the chapter again tonight.
tonight.zh: 我今晚打算再複習一次這一章。

too.en: The box is too heavy for one person to carry safely.
too.zh: 這個箱子太重，一個人搬並不安全。

tool.en: A calculator is a useful tool for checking numerical results.
tool.zh: 計算機是檢查數值結果的實用工具。

topic.en: Each group selected a different topic for the final presentation.
topic.zh: 每組為期末簡報選擇了不同主題。

total.en: The total cost was lower than our original estimate.

touch.en: Do not touch the equipment until the teacher gives permission.
touch.zh: 在老師允許前不要碰設備。

tour.en: The museum tour lasted about ninety minutes.
tour.zh: 博物館導覽大約持續九十分鐘。

toward.en: The students walked toward the gym after lunch.
toward.zh: 午餐後學生朝體育館走去。

town.en: The small town is famous for its old streets and local food.
town.zh: 這座小鎮以老街和在地美食聞名。

trace.en: Students trace the development of the idea across the passage.
trace.zh: 學生追蹤這個觀點在文章中的發展。

track.en: The app can track your study progress over time.
track.zh: 這個應用程式可以追蹤你的學習進度。

trade.en: International trade allows countries to exchange goods and services.
trade.zh: 國際貿易讓各國能交換商品與服務。

traditional.en: The festival includes traditional music, food, and local performances.
traditional.zh: 這個節慶包含傳統音樂、食物和地方表演。

traffic.en: Heavy traffic caused many students to arrive late.
traffic.zh: 交通壅塞造成許多學生遲到。

train.en: We took the train because it was faster than driving.
train.zh: 我們搭火車，因為比開車快。

transfer.en: You can transfer the file from your phone to the computer.
transfer.zh: 你可以把檔案從手機傳到電腦。

transform.en: Heat can transform ice into liquid water.
transform.zh: 熱能可以把冰轉變成液態水。

transition.en: The transition from junior high to senior high can take time.
transition.zh: 從國中過渡到高中需要一些時間。

transmit.en: The sensor can transmit temperature data to the computer wirelessly.
transmit.zh: 這個感測器可以無線傳送溫度資料到電腦。

transparent.en: A transparent process makes it easier for everyone to understand how decisions were made.
transparent.zh: 透明的流程讓每個人更容易理解決策是如何形成的。

transportation.en: Public transportation can reduce the number of cars on busy roads.
transportation.zh: 大眾運輸能減少繁忙道路上的汽車數量。

travel.en: Many students travel during vacation to experience different cultures.
travel.zh: 許多學生在假期旅行，體驗不同文化。

treat.en: Doctors treat different illnesses with different methods.
treat.zh: 醫師使用不同方法治療不同疾病。

treatment.en: The patient responded well to the new treatment.
treatment.zh: 這位病人對新的治療反應良好。

tree.en: The old tree provides shade beside the school playground.
tree.zh: 這棵老樹在學校操場旁提供樹蔭。

trend.en: The graph shows a steady upward trend over five years.
trend.zh: 這張圖表顯示五年間持續上升的趨勢。

trial.en: The first trial produced unexpected results, so we repeated the test.
trial.zh: 第一次試驗出現意外結果，因此我們重做測試。

trigger.en: A sudden temperature change can trigger an automatic safety response.
trigger.zh: 突然的溫度變化可能觸發自動安全反應。

trip.en: The class trip helped students learn outside the classroom.
trip.zh: 班級旅行幫助學生在課堂外學習。

trouble.en: Please ask for help if you have trouble understanding the instructions.
trouble.zh: 如果你在理解說明上遇到困難，請尋求幫助。

true.en: The statement is true only under certain conditions.
true.zh: 這個敘述只有在特定條件下才成立。

trust.en: Good teamwork depends on communication and mutual trust.
trust.zh: 良好的團隊合作仰賴溝通與彼此信任。

truth.en: The investigation tried to discover the truth behind the report.
truth.zh: 調查試圖找出這份報告背後的真相。

try.en: If the first method fails, try a different approach.
try.zh: 如果第一種方法失敗，就試試不同方式。

turn.en: Please turn the page and read the next paragraph.

type.en: This type of question requires careful reading of the passage.
type.zh: 這種類型的題目需要仔細閱讀文章。

typical.en: This is a typical example of how the pattern appears.
typical.zh: 這是這種模式如何出現的典型例子。

under.en: The books are stored under the desk near the window.

undergo.en: The building will undergo major repairs during the summer vacation.
undergo.zh: 這棟建築將在暑假期間進行大規模修繕。

underlying.en: The teacher asked us to identify the underlying cause of the problem.
underlying.zh: 老師要我們找出問題背後的根本原因。

undermine.en: Unreliable data can undermine confidence in the final conclusion.
undermine.zh: 不可靠的資料可能削弱大家對最終結論的信心。

understand.en: It is easier to remember a word when you understand its meaning.
understand.zh: 理解單字意思後會比較容易記住。

undertake.en: The class will undertake a small research project this semester.
undertake.zh: 全班這學期將進行一項小型研究專題。

uniform.en: All samples were kept under uniform conditions during the experiment.
uniform.zh: 所有樣本在實驗期間都維持一致的條件。

unify.en: A clear theme can unify the different sections of an essay.
unify.zh: 清楚的主題可以把文章不同部分統整起來。

unique.en: Each culture has unique traditions that reflect its history.
unique.zh: 每種文化都有反映自身歷史的獨特傳統。

unit.en: The next unit focuses on environmental problems and solutions.
unit.zh: 下一單元著重環境問題與解決方法。

universal.en: Access to clean water is a universal human need.
universal.zh: 取得乾淨用水是普遍的人類需求。

university.en: She hopes to study engineering at university in the future.
university.zh: 她希望未來在大學就讀工程相關科系。

unless.en: You cannot enter the laboratory unless a teacher is present.
unless.zh: 除非有老師在場，否則不能進入實驗室。

until.en: We stayed in the library until it closed.
until.zh: 我們待在圖書館直到關門。

up.en: Please look up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
up.zh: 請在字典中查這個不熟悉的單字。

update.en: The website will update the information automatically every morning.
update.zh: 網站每天早上會自動更新資訊。

upon.en: Upon arrival, students must report to the main office.
upon.zh: 抵達後，學生必須先到總務辦公室報到。

upper.en: The upper floor of the library is reserved for quiet study.
upper.zh: 圖書館樓上樓層保留作安靜自習使用。

urban.en: Urban areas often face challenges related to traffic and housing.
urban.zh: 都市地區常面臨交通和住房相關挑戰。

use.en: Students can use this website to review vocabulary at home.
use.zh: 學生可以在家使用這個網站複習單字。

useful.en: The chart provides useful information for comparing the two groups.
useful.zh: 這張圖表提供比較兩組時很有用的資訊。

user.en: Each user must create an account before saving progress.
user.zh: 每位使用者都必須先建立帳號才能儲存進度。

usual.en: The library is quieter than usual during the school holiday.
usual.zh: 學校放假期間圖書館比平常安靜。

usually.en: I usually review new vocabulary before going to bed.
usually.zh: 我通常在睡前複習新單字。

utilize.en: Students can utilize online databases to find reliable research sources.
utilize.zh: 學生可以利用線上資料庫尋找可靠的研究來源。

vacation.en: We spent part of the summer vacation visiting relatives in the south.
vacation.zh: 我們暑假的一部分時間到南部探望親戚。

valid.en: The conclusion is valid only if the measurements were collected correctly.
valid.zh: 只有在測量資料蒐集正確時，這個結論才有效。

valuable.en: The teacher gave us valuable advice about preparing for the exam.
valuable.zh: 老師給了我們一些準備考試的寶貴建議。

value.en: The survey asked students to rank each value by importance.
value.zh: 這份調查請學生依重要程度排列各項價值。

variable.en: Temperature was the only variable changed during the experiment.
variable.zh: 溫度是這項實驗中唯一被改變的變因。

variety.en: The school library offers a wide variety of books and magazines.
variety.zh: 學校圖書館提供種類豐富的書籍和雜誌。

various.en: Students used various sources to complete the research project.
various.zh: 學生使用各種資料來源完成研究專題。

vary.en: The results may vary depending on temperature and humidity.
vary.zh: 結果可能會依溫度和濕度而有所不同。

vehicle.en: Every vehicle must stop before entering the school gate.
vehicle.zh: 每一輛車進入校門前都必須停下來。

versatile.en: A versatile tool can perform several different tasks efficiently.
versatile.zh: 多功能的工具可以有效完成多種不同任務。

version.en: Please make sure you are using the latest version of the file.
version.zh: 請確認你使用的是這份檔案的最新版本。

very.en: The final question was very difficult for most students.
very.zh: 最後一題對大多數學生來說非常困難。

viable.en: The team selected the most viable solution after comparing costs.
viable.zh: 團隊比較成本後，選出最可行的解決方案。

victim.en: The news report focused on support available to each victim.
victim.zh: 新聞報導聚焦於每位受害者可以獲得的支援。

victory.en: The team celebrated its victory after a close final match.
victory.zh: 球隊在一場勢均力敵的決賽後慶祝勝利。

video.en: The teacher showed a short video to introduce the topic.
video.zh: 老師播放了一段短影片來介紹主題。

view.en: The mountain offers a beautiful view of the entire valley.
view.zh: 這座山可以看到整個山谷的美麗景色。

village.en: The small village is surrounded by farms and low hills.
village.zh: 這個小村莊周圍是農田和低矮山丘。

violence.en: The class discussed ways to prevent violence and improve school safety.
violence.zh: 全班討論如何預防暴力並提升校園安全。

violent.en: The movie contains some violent scenes and is not suitable for young children.
violent.zh: 這部電影有一些暴力場景，不適合年幼兒童。

visible.en: The small crack became visible under bright light.
visible.zh: 在強光下，那條小裂縫變得看得見。

visit.en: Our class will visit the science museum next month.
visit.zh: 我們班下個月將參觀科學博物館。

visitor.en: Each visitor must register at the front desk before entering.
visitor.zh: 每位訪客進入前都必須在櫃檯登記。

visual.en: A visual chart can make complicated data easier to understand.
visual.zh: 視覺化圖表可以讓複雜資料更容易理解。

vivid.en: The writer used vivid details to describe the changing landscape.
vivid.zh: 作者用生動的細節描寫正在改變的景觀。

voice.en: Her voice was clear enough for everyone to hear.
voice.zh: 她的聲音很清楚，大家都聽得見。

volume.en: The container can hold a large volume of water.
volume.zh: 這個容器可以裝下大量的水。

voluntary.en: Participation in the after-school survey is completely voluntary.
voluntary.zh: 參加課後問卷完全是自願的。

volunteer.en: Many students volunteer at community events during the weekend.
volunteer.zh: 許多學生週末會在社區活動中擔任志工。

vote.en: Students will vote for a new class representative tomorrow.
vote.zh: 學生明天將投票選出新的班級代表。

wait.en: Please wait outside until the teacher calls your name.
wait.zh: 請在外面等到老師叫你的名字。

wake.en: I usually wake before the alarm on school days.
wake.zh: 上學日我通常在鬧鐘響前就醒來。

walk.en: We decided to walk to the station instead of taking a bus.
walk.zh: 我們決定走路去車站，不搭公車。

wall.en: The class posted its project posters on the back wall.
wall.zh: 全班把專題海報貼在後面的牆上。

want.en: Many students want more time to prepare for major tests.
want.zh: 許多學生希望有更多時間準備重要考試。

war.en: The history lesson explained how the war changed daily life.
war.zh: 歷史課說明了戰爭如何改變日常生活。

warm.en: The classroom stayed warm even though it was cold outside.
warm.zh: 即使外面很冷，教室裡仍然很溫暖。

wash.en: Remember to wash your hands before preparing food.

waste.en: The school is trying to reduce food waste in the cafeteria.
waste.zh: 學校正努力減少餐廳的食物浪費。

watch.en: We stayed after class to watch a short documentary.
watch.zh: 我們下課後留下來看一部短紀錄片。

water.en: Plants need enough water and sunlight to grow well.
water.zh: 植物需要足夠的水和陽光才能好好生長。

wave.en: A large wave reached the rocks near the shore.
wave.zh: 一個大浪打到了岸邊的岩石。

way.en: There is more than one way to solve this problem.
way.zh: 這個問題不只一種解法。

we.en: We reviewed the key points before the test began.
we.zh: 考試開始前，我們複習了重點。

weak.en: The bridge model collapsed because one support was too weak.
weak.zh: 這座橋梁模型因其中一個支撐太脆弱而倒塌。

wealth.en: The article examines how wealth is distributed across different regions.
wealth.zh: 這篇文章探討財富如何分布在不同地區。

wear.en: Students must wear safety glasses during this experiment.
wear.zh: 學生進行這項實驗時必須戴護目鏡。

weather.en: The weather changed quickly as dark clouds moved in.
weather.zh: 烏雲移入後，天氣很快發生變化。

website.en: The school website provides updated information about upcoming events.
website.zh: 學校網站提供即將舉行活動的最新資訊。

week.en: We have a science quiz at the end of this week.
week.zh: 這週結束前我們有一場自然科小考。

weekend.en: She plans to finish the project over the weekend.
weekend.zh: 她計畫利用週末完成專題。

weight.en: The students measured the weight of each object carefully.
weight.zh: 學生仔細測量每個物體的重量。

welcome.en: New students are always welcome to join the club.
welcome.zh: 新生隨時都歡迎加入這個社團。

well.en: She explained the difficult idea very well during the presentation.
well.zh: 她在報告中把困難的概念解釋得很好。

west.en: The sun was setting in the west behind the mountains.
west.zh: 太陽正在山後的西方落下。

western.en: The course compares several eastern and western cultural traditions.
western.zh: 這門課比較數種東西方文化傳統。

wet.en: The floor was wet after students came in from the rain.
wet.zh: 學生淋雨進來後，地板變得濕濕的。

what.en: Please explain what you learned from the experiment.
what.zh: 請說明你從這個實驗中學到了什麼。

whatever.en: Whatever method you choose, make sure you can explain it clearly.
whatever.zh: 無論你選擇哪種方法，都要確保能清楚說明。

when.en: Tell me when you are ready to begin the presentation.
when.zh: 你準備好開始報告時告訴我。

where.en: The map shows where each station is located.
where.zh: 這張地圖顯示每個車站的位置。

whereas.en: The first method is faster, whereas the second is more accurate.
whereas.zh: 第一種方法較快，而第二種方法更準確。

whether.en: We need to decide whether the plan is practical enough.
whether.zh: 我們需要決定這個計畫是否夠實際。

which.en: Please choose which topic you want to research first.
which.zh: 請選擇你想先研究哪個主題。

while.en: She listened to music while organizing her notes.
while.zh: 她一邊整理筆記，一邊聽音樂。

white.en: The teacher used a white card to cover the answer.
white.zh: 老師用一張白色卡片遮住答案。

who.en: The teacher asked who wanted to present first.
who.zh: 老師問誰想第一個上台報告。

whole.en: The whole class worked together to prepare the exhibition.
whole.zh: 全班一起合作準備展覽。

why.en: Please explain why you chose this answer.
why.zh: 請說明你為什麼選這個答案。

wide.en: The river is too wide to cross without a bridge.
wide.zh: 這條河太寬，沒有橋就無法渡過。

widespread.en: Online learning became widespread in many schools during that period.
widespread.zh: 在那段期間，線上學習在許多學校變得很普遍。

wife.en: The writer thanked his wife for supporting his work.
wife.zh: 這位作家感謝妻子支持他的工作。

wild.en: Several wild birds gather near the lake every winter.
wild.zh: 每年冬天都有幾種野鳥聚集在湖邊。

will.en: Regular practice will improve your reading speed over time.
will.zh: 規律練習會逐漸提升你的閱讀速度。

win.en: The team hopes to win the final match this weekend.
win.zh: 球隊希望這個週末贏得決賽。

wind.en: Strong wind made it difficult to hold the umbrella.
wind.zh: 強風讓人很難撐穩雨傘。

window.en: Please open the window to let fresh air into the room.
window.zh: 請打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣進入房間。

wise.en: It is wise to check the facts before sharing information online.
wise.zh: 在網路分享資訊前先查證事實是明智的做法。

wish.en: I wish we had more time to discuss the final question.
wish.zh: 我希望我們有更多時間討論最後一題。

with.en: She solved the problem with help from her classmate.
with.zh: 她在同學協助下解決了這個問題。

withdraw.en: Students may withdraw from the activity before the final registration date.
withdraw.zh: 學生可以在最後報名日前退出這項活動。

within.en: Please submit the form within three days of receiving it.
within.zh: 請在收到表格後三天內繳交。

without.en: We finished the task without using a calculator.
without.zh: 我們沒有使用計算機就完成了這項任務。

woman.en: The woman gave a short talk about her research experience.
woman.zh: 那位女性分享了一場關於研究經驗的短講。

wonder.en: I wonder how the results would change with a larger sample.
wonder.zh: 我想知道樣本更大時結果會如何改變。

wonderful.en: The students did a wonderful job on their final presentations.
wonderful.zh: 學生的期末報告表現得非常好。

wood.en: The model was built from thin pieces of wood.
wood.zh: 這個模型由薄木片製成。

word.en: Try to understand each word from its context before using a dictionary.
word.zh: 查字典前，先試著從語境理解每個單字。

work.en: Group work can be effective when everyone has a clear role.
work.zh: 當每個人都有明確角色時，小組合作會很有效。

worker.en: Each worker received safety training before entering the site.
worker.zh: 每位工作人員進入現場前都接受了安全訓練。

world.en: The internet connects people from many parts of the world.
world.zh: 網路連結了世界各地的人。

worry.en: Try not to worry before you know the final result.
worry.zh: 在知道最後結果前，盡量不要擔心。

worth.en: The book is worth reading because it explains the topic clearly.
worth.zh: 這本書值得一讀，因為它把主題解釋得很清楚。

write.en: Please write a short summary after reading the article.
write.zh: 讀完文章後請寫一篇簡短摘要。

writer.en: The writer uses simple examples to explain complex ideas.
writer.zh: 這位作家用簡單例子解釋複雜概念。

wrong.en: The answer was wrong because one important step was missing.
wrong.zh: 這個答案錯了，因為少了一個重要步驟。

yard.en: The children played in the yard after finishing their homework.
yard.zh: 孩子們做完功課後在院子裡玩。

year.en: The school adds several new courses every year.
year.zh: 學校每年都會新增幾門課。

yellow.en: The yellow sign marks the entrance to the hiking trail.
yellow.zh: 黃色標誌標示了健行步道入口。

yes.en: She answered yes after thinking about the question carefully.
yes.zh: 她仔細思考問題後回答了是。

yesterday.en: We finished the first part of the project yesterday.
yesterday.zh: 我們昨天完成了專題的第一部分。

yet.en: The final results are not available yet.
yet.zh: 最終結果目前還沒有公布。

yield.en: The new method can yield more accurate results with less time.
yield.zh: 這種新方法可以用更少時間得到更準確的結果。

you.en: You should review the instructions before starting the test.
you.zh: 你應該在開始考試前先複習說明。

young.en: Young learners often improve quickly when they practice every day.
young.zh: 年輕學習者每天練習時通常進步得很快。

your.en: Please write your student number at the top of the page.
your.zh: 請在頁面上方寫上你的學號。

youth.en: The community center offers several programs for local youth.
youth.zh: 社區中心為當地青少年提供數項活動。

zero.en: The temperature fell close to zero during the night.
zero.zh: 夜間氣溫降到接近零度。

zone.en: This area is a quiet zone during examination periods.
zone.zh: 考試期間這個區域是安靜區。

adequately.en: The report adequately explains how the data were collected and checked.
adequately.zh: 這份報告充分說明資料如何被蒐集與檢查。

aggregate.en: The report presents aggregate data from all participating schools.
aggregate.zh: 這份報告呈現所有參與學校的彙總資料。

amazing.en: The telescope gave us an amazing view of the night sky.
amazing.zh: 望遠鏡讓我們看到令人驚嘆的夜空景象。

anymore.en: We do not use that old computer anymore.
anymore.zh: 我們已經不再使用那台舊電腦了。

appealing.en: The new layout is visually appealing and easier to navigate.
appealing.zh: 新的版面在視覺上更吸引人，也更容易操作。

appraisal.en: The teacher gave a careful appraisal of our presentation skills.
appraisal.zh: 老師仔細評估了我們的簡報能力。

automatically.en: The app automatically saves your work every few minutes.
automatically.zh: 這個應用程式每隔幾分鐘會自動儲存你的工作。

autumn.en: The leaves begin to change color in early autumn.

classroom.en: The classroom became quiet as soon as the test began.
classroom.zh: 考試一開始，教室立刻安靜下來。

coexist.en: Different viewpoints can coexist within the same classroom discussion.
coexist.zh: 不同觀點可以在同一場課堂討論中並存。

complicated.en: The instructions looked complicated until the teacher demonstrated each step.
complicated.zh: 在老師逐步示範前，這些說明看起來很複雜。

confer.en: The judges will confer before announcing the final result.
confer.zh: 評審會在公布最後結果前先討論。

confused.en: I felt confused until the teacher explained the final step.
confused.zh: 直到老師解釋最後一步，我才不再感到困惑。

denote.en: In this chart, a darker shade can denote a higher value.
denote.zh: 在這張圖表中，較深的色階可以表示較高的數值。

denounce.en: The editorial chose to denounce the spread of false information.
denounce.zh: 這篇社論選擇譴責錯誤資訊的散播。

detailed.en: The guide gives detailed instructions for each step of the process.
detailed.zh: 這份指南提供每個步驟的詳細說明。

deteriorate.en: The condition of the equipment may deteriorate without regular maintenance.
deteriorate.zh: 若沒有定期保養，設備狀況可能會惡化。

disperse.en: Strong winds can disperse smoke across a wide area.
disperse.zh: 強風可以把煙霧吹散到廣大區域。

displace.en: A large object can displace more water than a small one.
displace.zh: 大型物體可以排開比小型物體更多的水。

distort.en: A poor scale can distort the way data appear on a graph.
distort.zh: 不恰當的比例尺可能扭曲資料在圖表上的呈現方式。

effectively.en: Students need to learn how to manage their time effectively.
effectively.zh: 學生需要學會如何有效管理時間。

empirical.en: The conclusion is supported by empirical evidence from repeated experiments.
empirical.zh: 這項結論有重複實驗所得的實證證據支持。

erode.en: Heavy rain can slowly erode soil on an unprotected hillside.
erode.zh: 大雨會逐漸侵蝕沒有保護的山坡土壤。

illegal.en: It is illegal to enter the protected area without permission.
illegal.zh: 未經許可進入保護區是違法的。

impartial.en: An impartial judge should evaluate every team by the same standard.
impartial.zh: 公正的評審應以相同標準評估每一隊。

intricate.en: The diagram explains an intricate process using several simple stages.
intricate.zh: 這張圖用幾個簡單階段說明複雜的過程。

invoke.en: The program can invoke a backup process when an error occurs.
invoke.zh: 程式發生錯誤時可以啟動備援程序。

naturally.en: Children naturally learn many things by observing people around them.
naturally.zh: 孩子天生會透過觀察身邊的人學到許多事。

negligible.en: The difference between the two measurements was negligible.
negligible.zh: 兩次測量之間的差異小到可以忽略。

nine.en: The meeting starts at nine tomorrow morning.
nine.zh: 會議明天早上九點開始。

obviously.en: The machine was obviously damaged and could not be used safely.
obviously.zh: 這台機器顯然已損壞，無法安全使用。

one.en: Choose one example that best supports your main point.
one.zh: 選一個最能支持你主要論點的例子。

relatively.en: The second method is relatively simple compared with the first.
relatively.zh: 和第一種方法相比，第二種方法相對簡單。

terminate.en: The system will terminate the process if a serious error appears.
terminate.zh: 如果出現嚴重錯誤，系統會終止該程序。

three.en: The experiment was repeated three times to confirm the result.
three.zh: 這個實驗重複了三次，以確認結果。

ultimately.en: Ultimately, the team chose the simplest and safest design.
ultimately.zh: 最後，團隊選擇了最簡單也最安全的設計。

validity.en: The researcher questioned the validity of the original survey results.
validity.zh: 研究人員質疑原始調查結果的有效性。

verify.en: Students should verify important facts before including them in a report.
verify.zh: 學生在把重要事實寫進報告前應先加以查證。

warning.en: The weather service issued a warning before the heavy rain arrived.
warning.zh: 大雨到來前，氣象單位發布了警報。

whereby.en: The class created a system whereby each student could share feedback.
whereby.zh: 全班建立了一套讓每位學生都能分享回饋的制度。

winter.en: The mountain receives heavy snow during the winter months.
winter.zh: 這座山在冬季會下很多雪。
